from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow


class TestDataFlow(unittest.TestCase):
    def _build_flow(self, source: str) -> dict:
        module = ast.parse(source)
        function_node = module.body[0]
        return build_data_flow(function_node)

    def test_simple_assignment_dependency(self) -> None:
        source = """
def compute(a, b):
    total = a + b
    return total
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertIn("total", flow["writes"])
        self.assertIn("a", flow["reads"])
        self.assertIn("b", flow["reads"])
        self.assertIn("total", flow["return_reads"])
        self.assertEqual(len(flow["dependencies"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(flow["dependencies"][0]["target"], "total")
        self.assertEqual(flow["dependencies"][0]["sources"], ["a", "b"])

    def test_attribute_write_is_captured(self) -> None:
        source = """
def update(self, scale, base):
    self.amplitude_scale = scale + base
    return self.amplitude_scale
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertIn("self.amplitude_scale", flow["writes"])
        self.assertIn("self.amplitude_scale", flow["attribute_writes"])
        self.assertIn("scale", flow["reads"])
        self.assertIn("base", flow["reads"])
        self.assertIn("self.amplitude_scale", flow["return_reads"])

    def test_augassign_keeps_target_dependency(self) -> None:
        source = """
def bump(counter, step):
    counter += step
    return counter
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertIn("counter", flow["writes"])
        self.assertIn("counter", flow["reads"])
        self.assertIn("step", flow["reads"])
        self.assertEqual(len(flow["dependencies"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(flow["dependencies"][0]["target"], "counter")
        self.assertEqual(flow["dependencies"][0]["sources"], ["step", "counter"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Perfeito. Agora o bug ficou totalmente claro.

O problema não é mais só AugAssign.
O helper _extract_reads_from_expr(...) não está capturando corretamente nomes simples e atributos no contexto de return, e também não está tratando o alvo de AugAssign como leitura anterior.

Então vamos corrigir o algoritmo de forma limpa.

por esta versão:

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from typing import Any


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
        return _name_from_node(node.value)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _safe_unparse(node: ast.AST | None) -> str:
    if node is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return " ".join(ast.unparse(node).split())
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _append_unique(value: str, items: list[str]) -> None:
    if value and value not in items:
        items.append(value)


def _extract_reads_from_expr(node: ast.AST | None) -> list[str]:
    reads: list[str] = []

    if node is None:
        return reads

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Name(self, name_node: ast.Name) -> None:
            _append_unique(name_node.id, reads)

        def visit_Attribute(self, attr_node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(attr_node)
            _append_unique(name, reads)
            self.generic_visit(attr_node.value)

    Visitor().visit(node)
    return reads


def _extract_write_targets(target_node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    targets: list[str] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Name(self, name_node: ast.Name) -> None:
            _append_unique(name_node.id, targets)

        def visit_Attribute(self, attr_node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(attr_node)
            _append_unique(name, targets)
            self.generic_visit(attr_node.value)

        def visit_Tuple(self, tuple_node: ast.Tuple) -> None:
            for elt in tuple_node.elts:
                self.visit(elt)

        def visit_List(self, list_node: ast.List) -> None:
            for elt in list_node.elts:
                self.visit(elt)

        def visit_Subscript(self, sub_node: ast.Subscript) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(sub_node)
            if name:
                _append_unique(name, targets)
            self.generic_visit(sub_node.value)

    Visitor().visit(target_node)
    return targets


def _record_dependency(
    dependencies: list[dict[str, Any]],
    target: str,
    sources: list[str],
    line: int | None,
    expr: str,
) -> None:
    if not target:
        return
    dependencies.append(
        {
            "target": target,
            "sources": sources,
            "line": line,
            "expr": expr,
        }
    )


def build_data_flow(function_node: ast.AST) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reads: list[str] = []
    writes: list[str] = []
    return_reads: list[str] = []
    dependencies: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    module_writes: list[str] = []
    attribute_writes: list[str] = []

    for stmt in ast.walk(function_node):
        if isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)

            for target_node in stmt.targets:
                targets = _extract_write_targets(target_node)
                for target in targets:
                    _append_unique(target, writes)
                    if "." in target:
                        _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                    else:
                        _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                    _record_dependency(
                        dependencies,
                        target,
                        sources,
                        getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                        _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                    )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.AnnAssign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)

            targets = _extract_write_targets(stmt.target)
            for target in targets:
                _append_unique(target, writes)
                if "." in target:
                    _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                else:
                    _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                _record_dependency(
                    dependencies,
                    target,
                    sources,
                    getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.AugAssign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            targets = _extract_write_targets(stmt.target)

            dependency_sources: list[str] = []
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)
                _append_unique(source, dependency_sources)

            for target in targets:
                _append_unique(target, reads)
                _append_unique(target, writes)
                _append_unique(target, dependency_sources)
                if "." in target:
                    _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                else:
                    _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                _record_dependency(
                    dependencies,
                    target,
                    dependency_sources,
                    getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.Return):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)
                _append_unique(source, return_reads)

    return {
        "reads": reads,
        "writes": writes,
        "return_reads": return_reads,
        "attribute_writes": attribute_writes,
        "module_writes": module_writes,
        "dependencies": dependencies,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def collect_visualizer_state(visualizer: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    state: dict[str, Any] = {}

    state["main_window_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "main_window", None) is not None
    state["notebook_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "notebook", None) is not None
    state["splash_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "splash", None) is not None
    state["timeline_widget_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "timeline_widget", None) is not None
    state["canvas_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "canvas", None) is not None
    state["raw_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "raw", None) is not None
    state["data_exists"] = getattr(visualizer, "data", None) is not None

    state["current_start"] = getattr(visualizer, "current_start", None)
    state["window_size"] = getattr(visualizer, "window_size", None)
    state["amplitude_scale"] = getattr(visualizer, "amplitude_scale", None)
    state["total_duration"] = getattr(visualizer, "total_duration", None)

    notebook = getattr(visualizer, "notebook", None)
    if notebook is not None:
        try:
            state["current_tab"] = notebook.tabText(notebook.currentIndex())
        except Exception:
            state["current_tab"] = ""
    else:
        state["current_tab"] = ""

    return state

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from runtime_trace_models import TraceEvent, TraceIssue, TraceStateSnapshot
from runtime_trace_utils import now_iso, safe_json_dump, sanitize_data, sanitize_text


class RuntimeTraceWriter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.project_root: str = ""
        self.entry_script: str = ""
        self.output_path: Path | None = None

        self._event_counter = 0
        self._snapshot_counter = 0
        self._issue_counter = 0

        self.events: list[TraceEvent] = []
        self.state_snapshots: list[TraceStateSnapshot] = []
        self.errors: list[TraceIssue] = []
        self.warnings: list[TraceIssue] = []

    def configure(
        self,
        *,
        project_root: str,
        output_path: str,
        entry_script: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        self.project_root = sanitize_text(project_root)
        self.entry_script = sanitize_text(entry_script)
        self.output_path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()

    def trace_event(
        self,
        *,
        event_type: str,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str = "",
        object_name: str = "",
        object_type: str = "",
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._event_counter += 1
        self.events.append(
            TraceEvent(
                event_id=self._event_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                event_type=sanitize_text(event_type),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                object_name=sanitize_text(object_name),
                object_type=sanitize_text(object_type),
                extra=sanitize_data(extra or {}),
            )
        )

    def trace_state_snapshot(
        self,
        *,
        label: str,
        state: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        self._snapshot_counter += 1
        self.state_snapshots.append(
            TraceStateSnapshot(
                snapshot_id=self._snapshot_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                label=sanitize_text(label),
                state=sanitize_data(state),
            )
        )

    def trace_error(
        self,
        *,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._issue_counter += 1
        self.errors.append(
            TraceIssue(
                issue_id=self._issue_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                extra=sanitize_data(extra or {}),
            )
        )

    def trace_warning(
        self,
        *,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._issue_counter += 1
        self.warnings.append(
            TraceIssue(
                issue_id=self._issue_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                extra=sanitize_data(extra or {}),
            )
        )

    def build_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "trace_info": {
                "trace_version": "1.0",
                "generated_at": now_iso(),
            },
            "session_info": {
                "project_root": self.project_root,
                "entry_script": self.entry_script,
            },
            "events": [
                {
                    "id": item.event_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "type": item.event_type,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "object_name": item.object_name,
                    "object_type": item.object_type,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.events
            ],
            "state_snapshots": [
                {
                    "id": item.snapshot_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "label": item.label,
                    "state": item.state,
                }
                for item in self.state_snapshots
            ],
            "errors": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.errors
            ],
            "warnings": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.warnings
            ],
        }

    def save(self) -> Path:
        if self.output_path is None:
            raise RuntimeError("RuntimeTraceWriter is not configured.")
        payload = self.build_payload()
        safe_json_dump(payload, self.output_path)
        return self.output_path

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter


_TRACE_WRITER: RuntimeTraceWriter | None = None


def configure_runtime_trace(
    *,
    project_root: str,
    output_path: str,
    entry_script: str = "",
) -> RuntimeTraceWriter:
    global _TRACE_WRITER
    _TRACE_WRITER = RuntimeTraceWriter()
    _TRACE_WRITER.configure(
        project_root=project_root,
        output_path=output_path,
        entry_script=entry_script,
    )
    return _TRACE_WRITER


def get_runtime_trace_writer() -> RuntimeTraceWriter | None:
    return _TRACE_WRITER


def trace_event(
    *,
    event_type: str,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str = "",
    object_name: str = "",
    object_type: str = "",
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_event(
        event_type=event_type,
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        object_name=object_name,
        object_type=object_type,
        extra=extra,
    )


def trace_state_snapshot(
    *,
    label: str,
    state: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_state_snapshot(label=label, state=state)


def trace_error(
    *,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_error(
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        extra=extra,
    )


def trace_warning(
    *,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_warning(
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        extra=extra,
    )


def save_runtime_trace() -> Path | None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return None
    return writer.save()

                signal_name=sanitize_text(signal_name),
                receiver_type=sanitize_text(receiver_type),
                receiver_name=sanitize_text(receiver_name),
                slot_name=sanitize_text(slot_name),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_line=source_line,
                extra=sanitize_data(extra or {}),
            )
        )

    def build_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "trace_info": {
                "trace_version": "1.1",
                "generated_at": now_iso(),
            },
            "session_info": {
                "project_root": self.project_root,
                "entry_script": self.entry_script,
            },
            "events": [
                {
                    "id": item.event_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "type": item.event_type,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "object_name": item.object_name,
                    "object_type": item.object_type,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.events
            ],
            "signal_connections": [
                {
                    "id": item.connection_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "sender_type": item.sender_type,
                    "sender_name": item.sender_name,
                    "signal_name": item.signal_name,
                    "receiver_type": item.receiver_type,
                    "receiver_name": item.receiver_name,
                    "slot_name": item.slot_name,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_line": item.source_line,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.signal_connections
            ],
            "state_snapshots": [
                {
                    "id": item.snapshot_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "label": item.label,
                    "state": item.state,
                }
                for item in self.state_snapshots
            ],
            "errors": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.errors
            ],
            "warnings": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.warnings
            ],
        }

    def save(self) -> Path:
        if self.output_path is None:
            raise RuntimeError("RuntimeTraceWriter is not configured.")
        payload = self.build_payload()
        safe_json_dump(payload, self.output_path)
        return self.output_path

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
from typing import Any, Callable

from runtime_trace_api import trace_signal_connection


_ORIGINAL_CONNECT: Callable[..., Any] | None = None
_IS_INSTALLED = False


def _safe_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        if hasattr(value, "objectName"):
            name = value.objectName()
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        name = getattr(value, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""


def _safe_type_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return type(value).__name__
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _safe_signal_name(signal_instance: Any) -> str:
    for attr_name in ("signal", "_name", "__name__"):
        try:
            value = getattr(signal_instance, attr_name, "")
            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                return value
        except Exception:
            pass
    text = repr(signal_instance)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _safe_slot_name(slot: Any) -> str:
    if slot is None:
        return ""
    try:
        name = getattr(slot, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        if hasattr(slot, "__func__"):
            func = getattr(slot, "__func__")
            name = getattr(func, "__name__", "")
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    text = repr(slot)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _resolve_receiver(slot: Any) -> Any:
    if slot is None:
        return None
    try:
        bound_self = getattr(slot, "__self__", None)
        if bound_self is not None:
            return bound_self
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _caller_location() -> tuple[str, int | None]:
    try:
        frames = inspect.stack()
        for frame_info in frames[2:]:
            filename = frame_info.filename or ""
            if "qt_connection_monitor.py" in filename:
                continue
            return filename, frame_info.lineno
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "", None


def _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
    def wrapped_connect(signal_instance: Any, slot: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        receiver = _resolve_receiver(slot)
        source_file, source_line = _caller_location()

        trace_signal_connection(
            sender_type=_safe_type_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            sender_name=_safe_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            signal_name=_safe_signal_name(signal_instance),
            receiver_type=_safe_type_name(receiver),
            receiver_name=_safe_name(receiver),
            slot_name=_safe_slot_name(slot),
            source_file=source_file,
            source_line=source_line,
            extra={
                "args_count": len(args),
                "kwargs_keys": sorted(kwargs.keys()),
            },
        )
        return original_connect(signal_instance, slot, *args, **kwargs)

    return wrapped_connect


def install_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    try:
        original_connect = SignalInstance.connect
        wrapped_connect = _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect)
        SignalInstance.connect = wrapped_connect
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = original_connect
        _IS_INSTALLED = True
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def uninstall_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if not _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    if _ORIGINAL_CONNECT is None:
        return False

    try:
        SignalInstance.connect = _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = None
        _IS_INSTALLED = False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from runtime_trace_api import configure_runtime_trace, save_runtime_trace


DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(r"/")
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "DEVELOPER TOOLS"
    / "FULL_INSPECTOR_JSON_APP"
    / "project_runtime_trace_v1.json"
)


class RuntimeCollectorWindow(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner V10 Runtime Collector")
        self.resize(900, 460)

        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON))
        self.entry_script_edit = QLineEdit("manual_session")

        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse Project")
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse Output")
        self.configure_button = QPushButton("Configure Trace")
        self.save_button = QPushButton("Save Trace")

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.project_root_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_project_button, 0, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.output_json_edit, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_output_button, 1, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Entry script label:"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.entry_script_edit, 2, 1)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addStretch()
        row.addWidget(self.configure_button)
        row.addWidget(self.save_button)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid)
        main_layout.addLayout(row)
        main_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log:"))
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.configure_button.clicked.connect(self._configure_trace)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self._save_trace)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(str(text))

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        file_path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(file_path)

    def _configure_trace(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        entry_script = self.entry_script_edit.text().strip()

        configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_path=output_json,
            entry_script=entry_script,
        )

        self._append_log("Runtime trace configured.")
        self._append_log("Project root: " + project_root)
        self._append_log("Output JSON: " + output_json)
        self._append_log("Entry script: " + entry_script)

    def _save_trace(self) -> None:
        try:
            output_path = save_runtime_trace()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save failed", str(exc))
            self._append_log("Save failed: " + str(exc))
            return

        if output_path is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No trace", "Trace writer is not configured.")
            self._append_log("Trace writer is not configured.")
            return

        self._append_log("Trace saved to: " + str(output_path))
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Done", "Trace saved to:\n" + str(output_path))


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = RuntimeCollectorWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import wraps
from typing import Any, Callable

from runtime_trace_api import get_runtime_trace_writer


def trace_runtime_event(
    event_type: str,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
) -> Callable:
    def decorator(func: Callable) -> Callable:
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
            writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
            if writer is not None:
                writer.trace_event(
                    event_type=event_type,
                    source_file=source_file,
                    source_symbol=source_symbol,
                    message="entered",
                )

            try:
                result = func(*args, **kwargs)
            except Exception as exc:
                writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
                if writer is not None:
                    writer.trace_error(
                        source_file=source_file,
                        source_symbol=source_symbol,
                        message=str(exc),
                    )
                raise

            writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
            if writer is not None:
                writer.trace_event(
                    event_type=event_type,
                    source_file=source_file,
                    source_symbol=source_symbol,
                    message="completed",
                )

            return result

        return wrapper

    return decorator

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtGui import QCloseEvent
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from qt_hooks.qt_connection_monitor import (
    install_qt_connection_monitor,
    uninstall_qt_connection_monitor,
)
from runtime_trace_api import configure_runtime_trace, save_runtime_trace


DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "project_reasoner"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "project_runtime_trace_v1.json"
)


class RuntimeCollectorWindow(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner V10 Runtime Collector")
        self.resize(900, 460)

        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON))
        self.entry_script_edit = QLineEdit("manual_session")

        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse Project")
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse Output")
        self.configure_button = QPushButton("Configure Trace")
        self.save_button = QPushButton("Save Trace")

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._monitor_installed = False

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.project_root_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_project_button, 0, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.output_json_edit, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_output_button, 1, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Entry script label:"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.entry_script_edit, 2, 1)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addStretch()
        row.addWidget(self.configure_button)
        row.addWidget(self.save_button)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid)
        main_layout.addLayout(row)
        main_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log:"))
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.configure_button.clicked.connect(self._configure_trace)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self._save_trace)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(str(text))

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        file_path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(file_path)

    def _configure_trace(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        entry_script = self.entry_script_edit.text().strip()

        configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_path=output_json,
            entry_script=entry_script,
        )

        self._append_log("Runtime trace configured.")
        self._append_log("Project root: " + project_root)
        self._append_log("Output JSON: " + output_json)
        self._append_log("Entry script: " + entry_script)

        self._monitor_installed = install_qt_connection_monitor()
        if self._monitor_installed:
            self._append_log("Qt connection monitor installed.")
        else:
            self._append_log("Qt connection monitor not installed.")

    def _save_trace(self) -> None:
        try:
            output_path = save_runtime_trace()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save failed", str(exc))
            self._append_log("Save failed: " + str(exc))
            return

        if output_path is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No trace", "Trace writer is not configured.")
            self._append_log("Trace writer is not configured.")
            return

        self._append_log("Trace saved to: " + str(output_path))
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Done", "Trace saved to:\n" + str(output_path))

    def closeEvent(self, event: QCloseEvent) -> None:
        try:
            output_path = save_runtime_trace()
            if output_path is not None:
                self._append_log("Trace auto-saved on close: " + str(output_path))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._append_log("Auto-save on close failed: " + str(exc))

        try:
            if self._monitor_installed:
                ok = uninstall_qt_connection_monitor()
                self._append_log("Qt connection monitor removed: " + str(ok))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._append_log("Qt monitor removal failed: " + str(exc))

        super().closeEvent(event)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = RuntimeCollectorWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

@'
from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
from typing import Any, Callable

from runtime_trace_api import trace_signal_connection


_ORIGINAL_CONNECT: Callable[..., Any] | None = None
_IS_INSTALLED = False


def _safe_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        if hasattr(value, "objectName"):
            name = value.objectName()
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        name = getattr(value, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""


def _safe_type_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return type(value).__name__
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _safe_signal_name(signal_instance: Any) -> str:
    for attr_name in ("signal", "_name", "__name__"):
        try:
            value = getattr(signal_instance, attr_name, "")
            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                return value
        except Exception:
            pass
    text = repr(signal_instance)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _safe_slot_name(slot: Any) -> str:
    if slot is None:
        return ""
    try:
        name = getattr(slot, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        if hasattr(slot, "__func__"):
            func = getattr(slot, "__func__")
            name = getattr(func, "__name__", "")
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    text = repr(slot)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _resolve_receiver(slot: Any) -> Any:
    if slot is None:
        return None
    try:
        bound_self = getattr(slot, "__self__", None)
        if bound_self is not None:
            return bound_self
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _caller_location() -> tuple[str, int | None]:
    try:
        frames = inspect.stack()
        for frame_info in frames[2:]:
            filename = frame_info.filename or ""
            if "qt_connection_monitor.py" in filename:
                continue
            return filename, frame_info.lineno
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "", None


def _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
    def wrapped_connect(signal_instance: Any, slot: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        receiver = _resolve_receiver(slot)
        source_file, source_line = _caller_location()

        trace_signal_connection(
            sender_type=_safe_type_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            sender_name=_safe_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            signal_name=_safe_signal_name(signal_instance),
            receiver_type=_safe_type_name(receiver),
            receiver_name=_safe_name(receiver),
            slot_name=_safe_slot_name(slot),
            source_file=source_file,
            source_line=source_line,
            extra={
                "args_count": len(args),
                "kwargs_keys": sorted(kwargs.keys()),
            },
        )
        return original_connect(signal_instance, slot, *args, **kwargs)

    return wrapped_connect


def install_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    try:
        original_connect = SignalInstance.connect
        wrapped_connect = _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect)
        SignalInstance.connect = wrapped_connect
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = original_connect
        _IS_INSTALLED = True
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def uninstall_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if not _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    if _ORIGINAL_CONNECT is None:
        return False

    try:
        SignalInstance.connect = _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = None
        _IS_INSTALLED = False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

@'
from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
from typing import Any, Callable

from runtime_trace_api import trace_signal_connection


_ORIGINAL_CONNECT: Callable[..., Any] | None = None
_IS_INSTALLED = False


def _safe_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        if hasattr(value, "objectName"):
            name = value.objectName()
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        name = getattr(value, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""


def _safe_type_name(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return type(value).__name__
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _safe_signal_name(signal_instance: Any) -> str:
    for attr_name in ("signal", "_name", "__name__"):
        try:
            value = getattr(signal_instance, attr_name, "")
            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                return value
        except Exception:
            pass
    text = repr(signal_instance)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _safe_slot_name(slot: Any) -> str:
    if slot is None:
        return ""
    try:
        name = getattr(slot, "__name__", "")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name:
            return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        if hasattr(slot, "__func__"):
            func = getattr(slot, "__func__")
            name = getattr(func, "__name__", "")
            if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                return name
    except Exception:
        pass
    text = repr(slot)
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text[:200]
    return ""


def _resolve_receiver(slot: Any) -> Any:
    if slot is None:
        return None
    try:
        bound_self = getattr(slot, "__self__", None)
        if bound_self is not None:
            return bound_self
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _caller_location() -> tuple[str, int | None]:
    try:
        frames = inspect.stack()
        for frame_info in frames[2:]:
            filename = frame_info.filename or ""
            if "qt_connection_monitor.py" in filename:
                continue
            return filename, frame_info.lineno
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "", None


def _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
    def wrapped_connect(signal_instance: Any, slot: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        receiver = _resolve_receiver(slot)
        source_file, source_line = _caller_location()

        trace_signal_connection(
            sender_type=_safe_type_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            sender_name=_safe_name(getattr(signal_instance, "instance", None)),
            signal_name=_safe_signal_name(signal_instance),
            receiver_type=_safe_type_name(receiver),
            receiver_name=_safe_name(receiver),
            slot_name=_safe_slot_name(slot),
            source_file=source_file,
            source_line=source_line,
            extra={
                "args_count": len(args),
                "kwargs_keys": sorted(kwargs.keys()),
            },
        )
        return original_connect(signal_instance, slot, *args, **kwargs)

    return wrapped_connect


def install_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    try:
        original_connect = SignalInstance.connect
        wrapped_connect = _build_connect_wrapper(original_connect)
        SignalInstance.connect = wrapped_connect
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = original_connect
        _IS_INSTALLED = True
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def uninstall_qt_connection_monitor() -> bool:
    global _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
    global _IS_INSTALLED

    if not _IS_INSTALLED:
        return True

    try:
        from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance
    except Exception:
        return False

    if _ORIGINAL_CONNECT is None:
        return False

    try:
        SignalInstance.connect = _ORIGINAL_CONNECT
        _ORIGINAL_CONNECT = None
        _IS_INSTALLED = False
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

Perfeito. Agora o diagnóstico está claro.

O Step 3.1 está funcionalmente quase fechado:
a GUI salva o trace no caminho correto
a seção signal_connections existe no JSON
mas ela veio vazia

Causa provável e muito forte:
o monitor está sendo instalado tarde demais

Hoje o fluxo é:
a janela é criada
_connect_signals() roda no __init__
só depois, ao clicar em Configure Trace, o monitor é instalado

Então as conexões da própria janela já aconteceram antes do monitor existir.
Por isso o JSON tem signal_connections, mas vazio.

Vamos corrigir isso do jeito certo:
configurar um trace default e instalar o monitor antes de criar a janela.

Substitua apenas o arquivo
developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector\runner.py
por esta versão:

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtGui import QCloseEvent
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from qt_hooks.qt_connection_monitor import (
    install_qt_connection_monitor,
    uninstall_qt_connection_monitor,
)
from runtime_trace_api import configure_runtime_trace, save_runtime_trace


DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "project_reasoner"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "project_runtime_trace_v1.json"
)
DEFAULT_ENTRY_SCRIPT = "manual_session"


class RuntimeCollectorWindow(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner V10 Runtime Collector")
        self.resize(900, 460)

        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON))
        self.entry_script_edit = QLineEdit(DEFAULT_ENTRY_SCRIPT)

        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse Project")
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse Output")
        self.configure_button = QPushButton("Configure Trace")
        self.save_button = QPushButton("Save Trace")

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._monitor_installed = True

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.project_root_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_project_button, 0, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.output_json_edit, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_output_button, 1, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Entry script label:"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.entry_script_edit, 2, 1)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addStretch()
        row.addWidget(self.configure_button)
        row.addWidget(self.save_button)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid)
        main_layout.addLayout(row)
        main_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log:"))
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.configure_button.clicked.connect(self._configure_trace)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self._save_trace)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(str(text))

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        file_path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(file_path)

    def _configure_trace(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        entry_script = self.entry_script_edit.text().strip()

        configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_path=output_json,
            entry_script=entry_script,
        )

        self._append_log("Runtime trace configured.")
        self._append_log("Project root: " + project_root)
        self._append_log("Output JSON: " + output_json)
        self._append_log("Entry script: " + entry_script)

        self._append_log("Qt connection monitor active: " + str(self._monitor_installed))

    def _save_trace(self) -> None:
        try:
            output_path = save_runtime_trace()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save failed", str(exc))
            self._append_log("Save failed: " + str(exc))
            return

        if output_path is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No trace", "Trace writer is not configured.")
            self._append_log("Trace writer is not configured.")
            return

        self._append_log("Trace saved to: " + str(output_path))
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Done", "Trace saved to:\n" + str(output_path))

    def closeEvent(self, event: QCloseEvent) -> None:
        try:
            output_path = save_runtime_trace()
            if output_path is not None:
                self._append_log("Trace auto-saved on close: " + str(output_path))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._append_log("Auto-save on close failed: " + str(exc))

        try:
            if self._monitor_installed:
                ok = uninstall_qt_connection_monitor()
                self._append_log("Qt connection monitor removed: " + str(ok))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._append_log("Qt monitor removal failed: " + str(exc))

        super().closeEvent(event)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)

    configure_runtime_trace(
        project_root=str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        output_path=str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
        entry_script=DEFAULT_ENTRY_SCRIPT,
    )
    install_qt_connection_monitor()

    window = RuntimeCollectorWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")


def sanitize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    text = str(value)
    return text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore").decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")


def sanitize_data(data: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        return {
            sanitize_text(key): sanitize_data(value)
            for key, value in data.items()
        }
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return [sanitize_data(item) for item in data]
    if isinstance(data, tuple):
        return [sanitize_data(item) for item in data]
    if isinstance(data, str):
        return sanitize_text(data)
    return data


def safe_json_dump(data: Any, output_path: Path) -> None:
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    clean_data = sanitize_data(data)
    json_text = json.dumps(clean_data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    json_text = json_text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore").decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    output_path.write_text(json_text, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from runtime_trace_models import (
    TraceEvent,
    TraceIssue,
    TraceSignalConnection,
    TraceStateSnapshot,
)
from runtime_trace_utils import now_iso, safe_json_dump, sanitize_data, sanitize_text


class RuntimeTraceWriter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.project_root: str = ""
        self.entry_script: str = ""
        self.output_path: Path | None = None

        self._event_counter = 0
        self._snapshot_counter = 0
        self._issue_counter = 0
        self._connection_counter = 0

        self.events: list[TraceEvent] = []
        self.state_snapshots: list[TraceStateSnapshot] = []
        self.errors: list[TraceIssue] = []
        self.warnings: list[TraceIssue] = []
        self.signal_connections: list[TraceSignalConnection] = []

    def configure(
        self,
        *,
        project_root: str,
        output_path: str,
        entry_script: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        self.project_root = sanitize_text(project_root)
        self.entry_script = sanitize_text(entry_script)
        self.output_path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()

    def _build_stack_context(self, max_frames: int = 8) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        frames_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        try:
            stack = inspect.stack()
            for frame_info in stack[2:]:
                file_name = sanitize_text(frame_info.filename)
                function_name = sanitize_text(frame_info.function)

                if not file_name:
                    continue

                if file_name.endswith("runtime_trace_writer.py"):
                    continue

                frames_out.append(
                    {
                        "file": file_name,
                        "line": frame_info.lineno,
                        "function": function_name,
                    }
                )

                if len(frames_out) >= max_frames:
                    break
        except Exception:
            return []

        return frames_out

    def _merge_extra_with_stack(self, extra: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        merged = dict(extra or {})
        if "stack" not in merged:
            merged["stack"] = self._build_stack_context()
        return sanitize_data(merged)

    def trace_event(
        self,
        *,
        event_type: str,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str = "",
        object_name: str = "",
        object_type: str = "",
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._event_counter += 1
        self.events.append(
            TraceEvent(
                event_id=self._event_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                event_type=sanitize_text(event_type),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                object_name=sanitize_text(object_name),
                object_type=sanitize_text(object_type),
                extra=self._merge_extra_with_stack(extra),
            )
        )

    def trace_state_snapshot(
        self,
        *,
        label: str,
        state: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        self._snapshot_counter += 1
        self.state_snapshots.append(
            TraceStateSnapshot(
                snapshot_id=self._snapshot_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                label=sanitize_text(label),
                state=sanitize_data(state),
            )
        )

    def trace_error(
        self,
        *,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._issue_counter += 1
        self.errors.append(
            TraceIssue(
                issue_id=self._issue_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                extra=self._merge_extra_with_stack(extra),
            )
        )

    def trace_warning(
        self,
        *,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._issue_counter += 1
        self.warnings.append(
            TraceIssue(
                issue_id=self._issue_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_symbol=sanitize_text(source_symbol),
                message=sanitize_text(message),
                extra=self._merge_extra_with_stack(extra),
            )
        )

    def trace_signal_connection(
        self,
        *,
        sender_type: str,
        sender_name: str,
        signal_name: str,
        receiver_type: str,
        receiver_name: str,
        slot_name: str,
        source_file: str = "",
        source_line: int | None = None,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._connection_counter += 1
        self.signal_connections.append(
            TraceSignalConnection(
                connection_id=self._connection_counter,
                time=now_iso(),
                sender_type=sanitize_text(sender_type),
                sender_name=sanitize_text(sender_name),
                signal_name=sanitize_text(signal_name),
                receiver_type=sanitize_text(receiver_type),
                receiver_name=sanitize_text(receiver_name),
                slot_name=sanitize_text(slot_name),
                source_file=sanitize_text(source_file),
                source_line=source_line,
                extra=sanitize_data(extra or {}),
            )
        )

    def build_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "trace_info": {
                "trace_version": "1.2",
                "generated_at": now_iso(),
            },
            "session_info": {
                "project_root": self.project_root,
                "entry_script": self.entry_script,
            },
            "events": [
                {
                    "id": item.event_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "type": item.event_type,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "object_name": item.object_name,
                    "object_type": item.object_type,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.events
            ],
            "signal_connections": [
                {
                    "id": item.connection_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "sender_type": item.sender_type,
                    "sender_name": item.sender_name,
                    "signal_name": item.signal_name,
                    "receiver_type": item.receiver_type,
                    "receiver_name": item.receiver_name,
                    "slot_name": item.slot_name,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_line": item.source_line,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.signal_connections
            ],
            "state_snapshots": [
                {
                    "id": item.snapshot_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "label": item.label,
                    "state": item.state,
                }
                for item in self.state_snapshots
            ],
            "errors": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.errors
            ],
            "warnings": [
                {
                    "id": item.issue_id,
                    "time": item.time,
                    "source_file": item.source_file,
                    "source_symbol": item.source_symbol,
                    "message": item.message,
                    "extra": item.extra,
                }
                for item in self.warnings
            ],
        }

    def save(self) -> Path:
        if self.output_path is None:
            raise RuntimeError("RuntimeTraceWriter is not configured.")
        payload = self.build_payload()
        safe_json_dump(payload, self.output_path)
        return self.output_path

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent

from runtime_trace_api import configure_runtime_trace


class TestCallStackContext(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_event_includes_stack(self) -> None:
        writer = configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root="E:\\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis",
            output_path="E:\\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\\developer_tools\\project_reasoner\\reasoner_runtime_collector\\outputs\\test_call_stack_trace.json",
            entry_script="test_call_stack_context.py",
        )

        def nested_emit() -> None:
            writer.trace_event(
                event_type="test_event",
                source_file="test_file.py",
                source_symbol="nested_emit",
                message="hello",
            )

        nested_emit()

        payload = writer.build_payload()
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["events"]), 1)
        extra = payload["events"][0]["extra"]
        self.assertIn("stack", extra)
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(extra["stack"], list))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(extra["stack"]), 1)

    def test_error_includes_stack(self) -> None:
        writer = configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root="E:\\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis",
            output_path="E:\\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\\developer_tools\\project_reasoner\\reasoner_runtime_collector\\outputs\\test_call_stack_trace.json",
            entry_script="test_call_stack_context.py",
        )

        def nested_error() -> None:
            writer.trace_error(
                source_file="test_file.py",
                source_symbol="nested_error",
                message="boom",
            )

        nested_error()

        payload = writer.build_payload()
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["errors"]), 1)
        extra = payload["errors"][0]["extra"]
        self.assertIn("stack", extra)
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(extra["stack"], list))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(extra["stack"]), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def _run_git_command(repo_root: Path, args: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            ["git"] + args,
            cwd=str(repo_root),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="ignore",
            check=False,
        )
    except Exception:
        return False, ""

    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return False, completed.stderr.strip() or completed.stdout.strip()

    return True, completed.stdout


def _normalize_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]


def collect_git_metadata_for_file(repo_root: Path, file_path: Path) -> dict:
    try:
        relative_path = file_path.resolve().relative_to(repo_root.resolve())
    except Exception:
        relative_path = file_path

    rel_text = relative_path.as_posix()

    ok, count_output = _run_git_command(
        repo_root,
        ["log", "--follow", "--format=%H", "--", rel_text],
    )
    if not ok:
        return {
            "available": False,
            "last_commit_date": "",
            "commit_count": 0,
            "authors": [],
            "commit_subjects": [],
        }

    hashes = _normalize_lines(count_output)
    if not hashes:
        return {
            "available": False,
            "last_commit_date": "",
            "commit_count": 0,
            "authors": [],
            "commit_subjects": [],
        }

    ok, details_output = _run_git_command(
        repo_root,
        ["log", "--follow", "--format=%cI%x1f%an%x1f%s", "--", rel_text],
    )
    if not ok:
        return {
            "available": False,
            "last_commit_date": "",
            "commit_count": len(hashes),
            "authors": [],
            "commit_subjects": [],
        }

    authors: list[str] = []
    commit_subjects: list[str] = []
    last_commit_date = ""

    for index, line in enumerate(_normalize_lines(details_output)):
        parts = line.split("\x1f")
        commit_date = parts[0].strip() if len(parts) > 0 else ""
        author = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        subject = parts[2].strip() if len(parts) > 2 else ""

        if index == 0:
            last_commit_date = commit_date

        if author and author not in authors:
            authors.append(author)

        if subject:
            commit_subjects.append(subject)

    return {
        "available": True,
        "last_commit_date": last_commit_date,
        "commit_count": len(hashes),
        "authors": authors,
        "commit_subjects": commit_subjects,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_git import collect_git_metadata_for_file


class TestGitMetadata(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_repo_returns_unavailable(self) -> None:
        fake_root = Path("Z:\\this\\repo\\does\\not\\exist")
        fake_file = fake_root / "module.py"

        data = collect_git_metadata_for_file(fake_root, fake_file)

        self.assertFalse(data["available"])
        self.assertEqual(data["last_commit_date"], "")
        self.assertEqual(data["commit_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(data["authors"], [])
        self.assertEqual(data["commit_subjects"], [])

    def test_real_file_returns_expected_shape(self) -> None:
        repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
        file_path = repo_root / "developer_tools" / "project_reasoner" / "reasoner_context_collector" / "collector_main.py"

        data = collect_git_metadata_for_file(repo_root, file_path)

        self.assertIn("available", data)
        self.assertIn("last_commit_date", data)
        self.assertIn("commit_count", data)
        self.assertIn("authors", data)
        self.assertIn("commit_subjects", data)
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(data["authors"], list))
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(data["commit_subjects"], list))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path


def collect_coverage_for_file(repo_root: Path, file_path: Path) -> dict:
    _ = repo_root
    _ = file_path

    if importlib.util.find_spec("coverage") is None:
        return {
            "available": False,
            "coverage_percent": None,
            "tests_covering_file": [],
            "reason": "coverage package not installed",
        }

    coverage_files = list(repo_root.rglob(".coverage"))
    if not coverage_files:
        return {
            "available": False,
            "coverage_percent": None,
            "tests_covering_file": [],
            "reason": "coverage data file not found",
        }

    return {
        "available": False,
        "coverage_percent": None,
        "tests_covering_file": [],
        "reason": "coverage integration not yet connected to raw data reader",
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def _clean_lines(docstring: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = []
    for raw_line in (docstring or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line:
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def _extract_first_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return ""
    match = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text, maxsplit=1)
    return match[0].strip() if match else text.strip()


def _extract_prefixed_values(lines: list[str], prefixes: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    for line in lines:
        lowered = line.lower()
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if lowered.startswith(prefix):
                value = line[len(prefix):].strip(" :-")
                if value:
                    found.append(value)
                break

    return found


def _extract_param_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    params: list[dict] = []

    param_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"^@param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^:param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
    ]

    for line in lines:
        for pattern in param_patterns:
            match = pattern.match(line)
            if match:
                params.append(
                    {
                        "name": match.group("name").strip(),
                        "description": match.group("desc").strip(),
                    }
                )
                break

    return params


def _extract_return_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "@return",
        ":return:",
        "returns",
        "return",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def _extract_side_effect_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "side effects",
        "side effect",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def build_docstring_summary(docstring: str) -> dict:
    lines = _clean_lines(docstring)
    joined = " ".join(lines)

    return {
        "summary": _extract_first_sentence(joined),
        "params": _extract_param_lines(lines),
        "returns": _extract_return_lines(lines),
        "side_effects": _extract_side_effect_lines(lines),
    }

@'
from __future__ import annotations

import re


def _clean_lines(docstring: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = []
    for raw_line in (docstring or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line:
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def _extract_first_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return ""
    match = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text, maxsplit=1)
    return match[0].strip() if match else text.strip()


def _extract_prefixed_values(lines: list[str], prefixes: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    for line in lines:
        lowered = line.lower()
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if lowered.startswith(prefix):
                value = line[len(prefix):].strip(" :-")
                if value:
                    found.append(value)
                break

    return found


def _extract_param_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    params: list[dict] = []

    param_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"^@param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^:param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
    ]

    for line in lines:
        for pattern in param_patterns:
            match = pattern.match(line)
            if match:
                params.append(
                    {
                        "name": match.group("name").strip(),
                        "description": match.group("desc").strip(),
                    }
                )
                break

    return params


def _extract_return_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "@return",
        ":return:",
        "returns",
        "return",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def _extract_side_effect_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "side effects",
        "side effect",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def build_docstring_summary(docstring: str) -> dict:
    lines = _clean_lines(docstring)
    joined = " ".join(lines)

    return {
        "summary": _extract_first_sentence(joined),
        "params": _extract_param_lines(lines),
        "returns": _extract_return_lines(lines),
        "side_effects": _extract_side_effect_lines(lines),
    }
