from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
        "data_flow": build_data_flow(node),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow
from collector_docstrings import build_docstring_summary
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    docstring = _get_docstring(node)

    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": docstring,
        "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(docstring),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
        "data_flow": build_data_flow(node),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]
            class_docstring = _get_docstring(node)

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": class_docstring,
                    "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(class_docstring),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def _clean_lines(docstring: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = []
    for raw_line in (docstring or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line:
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def _extract_first_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return ""
    match = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text, maxsplit=1)
    return match[0].strip() if match else text.strip()


def _extract_prefixed_values(lines: list[str], prefixes: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    for line in lines:
        lowered = line.lower()
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if lowered.startswith(prefix):
                value = line[len(prefix):].strip(" :-")
                if value:
                    found.append(value)
                break

    return found


def _extract_param_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    params: list[dict] = []

    param_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"^@param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^:param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
    ]

    for line in lines:
        for pattern in param_patterns:
            match = pattern.match(line)
            if match:
                params.append(
                    {
                        "name": match.group("name").strip(),
                        "description": match.group("desc").strip(),
                    }
                )
                break

    return params


def _extract_return_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "@return",
        ":return:",
        "returns",
        "return",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def _extract_side_effect_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "side effects",
        "side effect",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def build_docstring_summary(docstring: str) -> dict:
    lines = _clean_lines(docstring)
    joined = " ".join(lines)

    return {
        "summary": _extract_first_sentence(joined),
        "params": _extract_param_lines(lines),
        "returns": _extract_return_lines(lines),
        "side_effects": _extract_side_effect_lines(lines),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_docstrings import build_docstring_summary


class TestDocstringSummary(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extracts_summary_params_returns_and_side_effects(self) -> None:
        docstring = """
        Reset the current EEG window and redraw the plot.

        @param visualizer: Main EEG visualizer instance
        @param force: Forces redraw even if cached
        @return: True when refresh succeeds
        Side effects: updates self.current_start and repaints canvas
        """

        data = build_docstring_summary(docstring)

        self.assertEqual(data["summary"], "Reset the current EEG window and redraw the plot.")
        self.assertEqual(len(data["params"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(data["params"][0]["name"], "visualizer")
        self.assertEqual(data["returns"], ["True when refresh succeeds"])
        self.assertEqual(data["side_effects"], ["updates self.current_start and repaints canvas"])

    def test_empty_docstring_returns_empty_structure(self) -> None:
        data = build_docstring_summary("")

        self.assertEqual(data["summary"], "")
        self.assertEqual(data["params"], [])
        self.assertEqual(data["returns"], [])
        self.assertEqual(data["side_effects"], [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def _clean_lines(docstring: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = []
    for raw_line in (docstring or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line:
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def _extract_first_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return ""
    match = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text, maxsplit=1)
    return match[0].strip() if match else text.strip()


def _extract_prefixed_values(lines: list[str], prefixes: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    for line in lines:
        lowered = line.lower()
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if lowered.startswith(prefix):
                value = line[len(prefix):].strip(" :-")
                if value:
                    found.append(value)
                break

    return found


def _extract_param_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    params: list[dict] = []

    param_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"^@param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^:param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
    ]

    for line in lines:
        for pattern in param_patterns:
            match = pattern.match(line)
            if match:
                params.append(
                    {
                        "name": match.group("name").strip(),
                        "description": match.group("desc").strip(),
                    }
                )
                break

    return params


def _extract_return_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "@return",
        ":return:",
        "returns",
        "return",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def _extract_side_effect_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "side effects",
        "side effect",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def build_docstring_summary(docstring: str) -> dict:
    lines = _clean_lines(docstring)
    joined = " ".join(lines)

    return {
        "summary": _extract_first_sentence(joined),
        "params": _extract_param_lines(lines),
        "returns": _extract_return_lines(lines),
        "side_effects": _extract_side_effect_lines(lines),
    }

from __future__ import annotations


def build_module_responsibility_summary(file_record: dict) -> dict:
    primary_role = file_record.get("primary_role", "") or "general_module"
    secondary_roles = file_record.get("secondary_roles", []) or []

    function_names = [item.get("name", "") for item in file_record.get("functions", []) if item.get("name")]
    class_names = [item.get("name", "") for item in file_record.get("classes", []) if item.get("name")]
    key_symbols = (class_names + function_names)[:10]

    key_imports = [item for item in file_record.get("imports", []) if item][:10]

    if key_symbols:
        symbol_text = ", ".join(key_symbols[:5])
        summary = f"This module primarily handles {primary_role} responsibilities and exposes key symbols such as {symbol_text}."
    else:
        summary = f"This module primarily handles {primary_role} responsibilities."

    if secondary_roles:
        summary += " Secondary roles include " + ", ".join(secondary_roles[:3]) + "."

    if key_imports:
        summary += " Key imports include " + ", ".join(key_imports[:5]) + "."

    return {
        "summary": summary,
        "primary_role": primary_role,
        "secondary_roles": secondary_roles,
        "key_symbols": key_symbols,
        "key_imports": key_imports,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_module_summary import build_module_responsibility_summary


class TestModuleSummary(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_builds_expected_summary_shape(self) -> None:
        file_record = {
            "primary_role": "ui_controller",
            "secondary_roles": ["event_handling", "plot_updates"],
            "functions": [{"name": "refresh_plot"}, {"name": "handle_click"}],
            "classes": [{"name": "MainWindow"}],
            "imports": ["PySide6.QtWidgets", "matplotlib"],
        }

        data = build_module_responsibility_summary(file_record)

        self.assertIn("summary", data)
        self.assertEqual(data["primary_role"], "ui_controller")
        self.assertEqual(data["secondary_roles"], ["event_handling", "plot_updates"])
        self.assertIn("MainWindow", data["key_symbols"])
        self.assertIn("refresh_plot", data["key_symbols"])
        self.assertIn("PySide6.QtWidgets", data["key_imports"])

    def test_handles_empty_record(self) -> None:
        data = build_module_responsibility_summary({})

        self.assertIn("summary", data)
        self.assertEqual(data["primary_role"], "general_module")
        self.assertEqual(data["secondary_roles"], [])
        self.assertEqual(data["key_symbols"], [])
        self.assertEqual(data["key_imports"], [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def _clean_lines(docstring: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = []
    for raw_line in (docstring or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if line:
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def _extract_first_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return ""
    match = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text, maxsplit=1)
    return match[0].strip() if match else text.strip()


def _extract_prefixed_values(lines: list[str], prefixes: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    for line in lines:
        lowered = line.lower()
        for prefix in prefixes:
            if lowered.startswith(prefix):
                value = line[len(prefix):].strip(" :-")
                if value:
                    found.append(value)
                break

    return found


def _extract_param_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    params: list[dict] = []

    param_patterns = [
        re.compile(r"^@param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^:param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(r"^param\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*[:\-]?\s*(?P<desc>.*)$", re.IGNORECASE),
    ]

    for line in lines:
        for pattern in param_patterns:
            match = pattern.match(line)
            if match:
                params.append(
                    {
                        "name": match.group("name").strip(),
                        "description": match.group("desc").strip(),
                    }
                )
                break

    return params


def _extract_return_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "@return",
        ":return:",
        "returns",
        "return",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def _extract_side_effect_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    prefixes = [
        "side effects",
        "side effect",
    ]
    return _extract_prefixed_values(lines, prefixes)


def build_docstring_summary(docstring: str) -> dict:
    lines = _clean_lines(docstring)
    joined = " ".join(lines)

    return {
        "summary": _extract_first_sentence(joined),
        "params": _extract_param_lines(lines),
        "returns": _extract_return_lines(lines),
        "side_effects": _extract_side_effect_lines(lines),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter


def _safe_list(value: object) -> list:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    return []


def build_module_centrality_index(import_graph: dict, call_edges: list[dict], symbol_index: dict) -> dict:
    module_scores: dict[str, dict] = {}

    for module_name, imports in import_graph.items():
        entry = module_scores.setdefault(
            module_name,
            {
                "imports_out": 0,
                "imports_in": 0,
                "calls_out": 0,
                "calls_in": 0,
                "score": 0,
            },
        )
        entry["imports_out"] = len(_safe_list(imports))

    for module_name, imports in import_graph.items():
        for imported_module in _safe_list(imports):
            if imported_module in module_scores:
                module_scores.setdefault(
                    imported_module,
                    {
                        "imports_out": 0,
                        "imports_in": 0,
                        "calls_out": 0,
                        "calls_in": 0,
                        "score": 0,
                    },
                )
                module_scores[imported_module]["imports_in"] += 1

    symbol_to_module: dict[str, str] = {}
    for symbol_name, meta in symbol_index.items():
        if isinstance(meta, dict):
            file_path = str(meta.get("file", ""))
            module_name = file_path[:-3].replace("/", ".") if file_path.endswith(".py") else file_path
            symbol_to_module[symbol_name] = module_name

    for edge in _safe_list(call_edges):
        if not isinstance(edge, dict):
            continue

        from_symbol = str(edge.get("from_symbol", ""))
        to_call = str(edge.get("to_call", ""))

        from_module = symbol_to_module.get(from_symbol, "")
        to_module = symbol_to_module.get(to_call, "")

        if from_module:
            module_scores.setdefault(
                from_module,
                {
                    "imports_out": 0,
                    "imports_in": 0,
                    "calls_out": 0,
                    "calls_in": 0,
                    "score": 0,
                },
            )
            module_scores[from_module]["calls_out"] += 1

        if to_module:
            module_scores.setdefault(
                to_module,
                {
                    "imports_out": 0,
                    "imports_in": 0,
                    "calls_out": 0,
                    "calls_in": 0,
                    "score": 0,
                },
            )
            module_scores[to_module]["calls_in"] += 1

    for module_name, metrics in module_scores.items():
        metrics["score"] = (
            metrics["imports_out"]
            + metrics["imports_in"]
            + metrics["calls_out"]
            + metrics["calls_in"]
        )

    return dict(sorted(module_scores.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]["score"], reverse=True))


def build_symbol_centrality_index(call_edges: list[dict]) -> dict:
    outgoing = Counter()
    incoming = Counter()

    for edge in _safe_list(call_edges):
        if not isinstance(edge, dict):
            continue

        from_symbol = str(edge.get("from_symbol", ""))
        to_call = str(edge.get("to_call", ""))

        if from_symbol:
            outgoing[from_symbol] += 1
        if to_call:
            incoming[to_call] += 1

    all_symbols = sorted(set(outgoing.keys()) | set(incoming.keys()))
    output: dict[str, dict] = {}

    for symbol_name in all_symbols:
        calls_out = outgoing.get(symbol_name, 0)
        calls_in = incoming.get(symbol_name, 0)
        output[symbol_name] = {
            "calls_out": calls_out,
            "calls_in": calls_in,
            "score": calls_out + calls_in,
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]["score"], reverse=True))


def build_top_project_hotspots(
    module_centrality_index: dict,
    symbol_centrality_index: dict,
    limit: int = 20,
) -> dict:
    top_modules = []
    top_symbols = []

    for module_name, metrics in list(module_centrality_index.items())[:limit]:
        top_modules.append(
            {
                "module": module_name,
                "score": metrics.get("score", 0),
            }
        )

    for symbol_name, metrics in list(symbol_centrality_index.items())[:limit]:
        top_symbols.append(
            {
                "symbol": symbol_name,
                "score": metrics.get("score", 0),
            }
        )

    return {
        "top_modules": top_modules,
        "top_symbols": top_symbols,
    }

Conteúdo de tests\test_centrality.py:

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_centrality import (
    build_module_centrality_index,
    build_symbol_centrality_index,
    build_top_project_hotspots,
)


class TestCentrality(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_symbol_centrality_counts_calls(self) -> None:
        call_edges = [
            {"from_symbol": "A.run", "to_call": "B.work"},
            {"from_symbol": "A.run", "to_call": "B.work"},
            {"from_symbol": "B.work", "to_call": "C.save"},
        ]

        result = build_symbol_centrality_index(call_edges)

        self.assertEqual(result["A.run"]["calls_out"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["B.work"]["calls_in"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["B.work"]["calls_out"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["C.save"]["calls_in"], 1)

    def test_module_centrality_uses_imports_and_calls(self) -> None:
        import_graph = {
            "pkg.a": ["pkg.b"],
            "pkg.b": [],
            "pkg.c": ["pkg.b"],
        }
        symbol_index = {
            "A.run": {"file": "pkg/a.py"},
            "B.work": {"file": "pkg/b.py"},
            "C.save": {"file": "pkg/c.py"},
        }
        call_edges = [
            {"from_symbol": "A.run", "to_call": "B.work"},
            {"from_symbol": "C.save", "to_call": "B.work"},
        ]

        result = build_module_centrality_index(import_graph, call_edges, symbol_index)

        self.assertEqual(result["pkg.b"]["imports_in"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["pkg.b"]["calls_in"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["pkg.a"]["imports_out"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["pkg.c"]["imports_out"], 1)

    def test_hotspots_limit_output(self) -> None:
        module_index = {
            "m1": {"score": 5},
            "m2": {"score": 4},
        }
        symbol_index = {
            "s1": {"score": 7},
            "s2": {"score": 3},
        }

        result = build_top_project_hotspots(module_index, symbol_index, limit=1)

        self.assertEqual(len(result["top_modules"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["top_symbols"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["top_modules"][0]["module"], "m1")
        self.assertEqual(result["top_symbols"][0]["symbol"], "s1")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations


def build_file_priority_index(
    files_payload: list[dict],
    module_centrality_index: dict,
) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for record in files_payload:
        path = record["path"]
        module_name = record["module_name"]
        centrality = module_centrality_index.get(module_name, {})

        score = 0
        reasons: list[str] = []

        if record.get("entry_markers"):
            score += 30
            reasons.append("entry_point")

        primary_role = record.get("primary_role", "")
        if primary_role in {"ui", "controller", "orchestrator", "application"}:
            score += 20
            reasons.append("high_level_role")

        if record.get("classes"):
            score += min(len(record["classes"]) * 3, 12)
            reasons.append("contains_classes")

        if "QApplication(" in record.get("source", ""):
            score += 20
            reasons.append("qt_application_bootstrap")

        inbound = int(centrality.get("imported_by_count", 0))
        outbound = int(centrality.get("imports_count", 0))
        calls_in = int(centrality.get("called_by_count", 0))
        calls_out = int(centrality.get("calls_count", 0))

        connectivity_score = min(inbound + outbound + calls_in + calls_out, 40)
        if connectivity_score:
            score += connectivity_score
            reasons.append("connectivity")

        out[path] = {
            "priority_score": score,
            "priority_level": (
                "critical" if score >= 70 else
                "high" if score >= 45 else
                "medium" if score >= 20 else
                "low"
            ),
            "reasons": reasons,
        }

    return out


def build_priority_ranking(file_priority_index: dict, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    ranked = [
        {
            "file": path,
            "priority_score": payload.get("priority_score", 0),
            "priority_level": payload.get("priority_level", "low"),
            "reasons": payload.get("reasons", []),
        }
        for path, payload in file_priority_index.items()
    ]
    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["priority_score"], item["file"]))
    return ranked[:limit]

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent

if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_priority import build_file_priority_index, build_priority_ranking


class TestPriority(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_entry_point_increases_priority(self) -> None:
        files_payload = [
            {
                "path": "app/main_window.py",
                "module_name": "app.main_window",
                "entry_markers": ["entry_candidate"],
                "primary_role": "ui",
                "classes": [{"name": "MainWindow"}],
                "source": "app = QApplication([])\n",
            },
            {
                "path": "app/helpers.py",
                "module_name": "app.helpers",
                "entry_markers": [],
                "primary_role": "utility",
                "classes": [],
                "source": "",
            },
        ]

        module_centrality_index = {
            "app.main_window": {
                "imported_by_count": 2,
                "imports_count": 3,
                "called_by_count": 4,
                "calls_count": 5,
            },
            "app.helpers": {
                "imported_by_count": 0,
                "imports_count": 1,
                "called_by_count": 0,
                "calls_count": 1,
            },
        }

        result = build_file_priority_index(files_payload, module_centrality_index)

        main_payload = result["app/main_window.py"]
        helper_payload = result["app/helpers.py"]

        self.assertGreater(
            main_payload["priority_score"],
            helper_payload["priority_score"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(main_payload["priority_level"], "critical")
        self.assertIn("entry_point", main_payload["reasons"])
        self.assertIn("high_level_role", main_payload["reasons"])
        self.assertIn("qt_application_bootstrap", main_payload["reasons"])
        self.assertIn("contains_classes", main_payload["reasons"])
        self.assertIn("connectivity", main_payload["reasons"])

    def test_priority_ranking_orders_by_score_desc_then_file_name(self) -> None:
        file_priority_index = {
            "z_module.py": {
                "priority_score": 40,
                "priority_level": "medium",
                "reasons": ["connectivity"],
            },
            "a_module.py": {
                "priority_score": 80,
                "priority_level": "critical",
                "reasons": ["entry_point"],
            },
            "b_module.py": {
                "priority_score": 80,
                "priority_level": "critical",
                "reasons": ["high_level_role"],
            },
        }

        ranking = build_priority_ranking(file_priority_index, limit=10)

        self.assertEqual(len(ranking), 3)
        self.assertEqual(ranking[0]["file"], "a_module.py")
        self.assertEqual(ranking[1]["file"], "b_module.py")
        self.assertEqual(ranking[2]["file"], "z_module.py")
        self.assertEqual(ranking[0]["priority_score"], 80)
        self.assertEqual(ranking[2]["priority_level"], "medium")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_insights import (
    get_entry_chain_summary,
    get_project_hotspot_summary,
    get_top_central_symbols,
    get_top_priority_files,
)


class TestCollectorInsights(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_get_top_priority_files_sorts_descending(self) -> None:
        payload = {
            "priority_ranking": [
                {"path": "c.py", "priority_score": 4.0},
                {"path": "a.py", "priority_score": 9.5},
                {"path": "b.py", "priority_score": 7.0},
            ]
        }

        result = get_top_priority_files(payload, limit=2)

        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["path"], "a.py")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["path"], "b.py")

    def test_get_project_hotspot_summary_returns_expected_lists(self) -> None:
        payload = {
            "project_hotspots": {
                "top_modules": [
                    {"module_name": "alpha", "score": 10},
                    {"module_name": "beta", "score": 8},
                ],
                "top_symbols": [
                    {"symbol": "A.run", "score": 9},
                    {"symbol": "B.load", "score": 7},
                ],
            }
        }

        result = get_project_hotspot_summary(payload)

        self.assertIn("top_modules", result)
        self.assertIn("top_symbols", result)
        self.assertEqual(result["top_modules"][0]["module_name"], "alpha")
        self.assertEqual(result["top_symbols"][0]["symbol"], "A.run")

    def test_get_top_central_symbols_uses_symbol_centrality_index(self) -> None:
        payload = {
            "symbol_centrality_index": {
                "A.run": {"score": 12.0, "inbound_calls": 5, "outbound_calls": 7},
                "B.load": {"score": 4.0, "inbound_calls": 2, "outbound_calls": 2},
                "C.save": {"score": 8.0, "inbound_calls": 3, "outbound_calls": 5},
            }
        }

        result = get_top_central_symbols(payload, limit=2)

        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["symbol"], "A.run")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["symbol"], "C.save")

    def test_get_entry_chain_summary_returns_entry_and_chains(self) -> None:
        payload = {
            "project_summary": {
                "entry_files": [
                    "app.py",
                    "runner.py",
                ]
            },
            "execution_chains": {
                "app.py": [
                    {
                        "entry_file": "app.py",
                        "chain": ["main", "build_ui", "show_window"],
                    }
                ],
                "runner.py": [
                    {
                        "entry_file": "runner.py",
                        "chain": ["bootstrap", "run"],
                    }
                ],
            },
        }

        result = get_entry_chain_summary(payload)

        self.assertIn("entry_files", result)
        self.assertIn("entry_chains", result)
        self.assertEqual(result["entry_files"][0], "app.py")
        self.assertEqual(result["entry_chains"]["app.py"][0]["chain"][0], "main")
        self.assertEqual(result["entry_chains"]["runner.py"][0]["chain"][-1], "run")

    def test_missing_sections_return_safe_defaults(self) -> None:
        payload = {}

        top_files = get_top_priority_files(payload, limit=5)
        hotspots = get_project_hotspot_summary(payload)
        symbols = get_top_central_symbols(payload, limit=5)
        chains = get_entry_chain_summary(payload)

        self.assertEqual(top_files, [])
        self.assertEqual(hotspots["top_modules"], [])
        self.assertEqual(hotspots["top_symbols"], [])
        self.assertEqual(symbols, [])
        self.assertEqual(chains["entry_files"], [])
        self.assertEqual(chains["entry_chains"], {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def get_top_priority_files(payload: dict[str, Any], limit: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    ranking = payload.get("priority_ranking", [])
    if not isinstance(ranking, list):
        return []

    valid_items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in ranking:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            valid_items.append(item)

    sorted_items = sorted(
        valid_items,
        key=lambda item: float(item.get("priority_score", 0.0)),
        reverse=True,
    )
    return sorted_items[:limit]


def get_project_hotspot_summary(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    hotspots = payload.get("project_hotspots", {})
    if not isinstance(hotspots, dict):
        return {
            "top_modules": [],
            "top_symbols": [],
        }

    top_modules = hotspots.get("top_modules", [])
    top_symbols = hotspots.get("top_symbols", [])

    if not isinstance(top_modules, list):
        top_modules = []
    if not isinstance(top_symbols, list):
        top_symbols = []

    return {
        "top_modules": [item for item in top_modules if isinstance(item, dict)],
        "top_symbols": [item for item in top_symbols if isinstance(item, dict)],
    }


def get_top_central_symbols(payload: dict[str, Any], limit: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    centrality_index = payload.get("symbol_centrality_index", {})
    if not isinstance(centrality_index, dict):
        return []

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for symbol, data in centrality_index.items():
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "symbol": symbol,
                "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
                "inbound_calls": int(data.get("inbound_calls", 0)),
                "outbound_calls": int(data.get("outbound_calls", 0)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(key=lambda item: item["score"], reverse=True)
    return rows[:limit]


def get_entry_chain_summary(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    project_summary = payload.get("project_summary", {})
    execution_chains = payload.get("execution_chains", {})

    if not isinstance(project_summary, dict):
        project_summary = {}
    if not isinstance(execution_chains, dict):
        execution_chains = {}

    entry_files = project_summary.get("entry_files", [])
    if not isinstance(entry_files, list):
        entry_files = []

    entry_chains: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}

    for entry_file in entry_files:
        chains = execution_chains.get(entry_file, [])
        if not isinstance(chains, list):
            chains = []

        entry_chains[str(entry_file)] = [
            item for item in chains if isinstance(item, dict)
        ]

    return {
        "entry_files": entry_files,
        "entry_chains": entry_chains,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from collector_ast import parse_python_file
from collector_chains import build_execution_chains
from collector_config import CollectorConfig
from collector_duplicates import find_duplicate_symbols
from collector_output import build_collection_config, build_collector_info
from collector_ownership import build_object_ownership_map
from collector_qt import extract_qt_signal_map
from collector_roles import summarize_file_semantics, summarize_symbol_semantics
from collector_state import build_attribute_state_map
from collector_subsystems import build_subsystem_summaries
from collector_tests import link_tests_to_sources
from collector_utils import normalize_path, safe_json_dump
from collector_walker import walk_python_files_filtered
from collector_git import collect_git_metadata_for_file
from collector_coverage import collect_coverage_for_file
from collector_module_summary import build_module_responsibility_summary
from collector_priority import build_file_priority_index, build_priority_ranking

from collector_centrality import (
    build_module_centrality_index,
    build_symbol_centrality_index,
    build_top_project_hotspots,
)

from collector_insights import (
    get_entry_chain_summary,
    get_project_hotspot_summary,
    get_top_central_symbols,
    get_top_priority_files,
)

def _build_coverage_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("coverage_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }

def _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("git_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }

def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets

def _build_module_summary_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("module_responsibility_summary", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }

def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        git_metadata = collect_git_metadata_for_file(root, path)
        coverage_metadata = collect_coverage_for_file(root, path)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

        file_record = {
            "path": rel_path,
            "module_name": module_name,
            "imports": parsed["imports"],
            "classes": parsed["classes"],
            "functions": parsed["functions"],
            "docstring": docstring,
            "comments": comments,
            "strings": strings,
            "entry_markers": entry_markers,
            "ui_keyword_hits": [],
            "eeg_keyword_hits": [],
            "semantic_hints": semantic["evidence_terms"],
            "semantic_roles": semantic["roles"],
            "primary_role": semantic["primary_role"],
            "secondary_roles": semantic["secondary_roles"],
            "role_confidence": semantic["confidence"],
            "summary": f"{semantic['primary_role']} file" if semantic["primary_role"] else "general python module",
            "source": parsed["source"],
            "git_metadata": git_metadata,
            "coverage_metadata": coverage_metadata,
        }

        file_record["module_responsibility_summary"] = build_module_responsibility_summary(file_record)

        files_payload.append(file_record)

    symbol_index = _build_symbol_index(files_payload)
    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)
    call_edges = _build_call_edges(files_payload)
    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)
    object_ownership = build_object_ownership_map(files_payload)
    execution_chains = build_execution_chains(files_payload, entry_files)
    subsystems = build_subsystem_summaries(files_payload)
    symbol_summaries = _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload)
    snippet_index = _build_snippet_index(files_payload, config.max_snippet_lines)
    duplicate_symbols = find_duplicate_symbols(files_payload)
    test_links = link_tests_to_sources(files_payload)

    module_centrality_index = build_module_centrality_index(
        import_graph,
        call_edges,
        symbol_index,
    )
    symbol_centrality_index = build_symbol_centrality_index(call_edges)
    project_hotspots = build_top_project_hotspots(
        module_centrality_index,
        symbol_centrality_index,
        limit=25,
    )

    file_priority_index = build_file_priority_index(
        files_payload,
        module_centrality_index,
    )
    priority_ranking = build_priority_ranking(file_priority_index, limit=50)

    git_metadata_index = _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload)
    coverage_index = _build_coverage_index(files_payload)
    module_summary_index = _build_module_summary_index(files_payload)

    output = {
        "collector_info": build_collector_info(root),
        "project_summary": {
            "project_root": str(root),
            "python_file_count": len(files_payload),
            "entry_file_count": len(entry_files),
            "entry_files": sorted(set(entry_files)),
            "parse_error_count": len(errors),
            "git_metadata": git_metadata_index,
            "coverage_index": coverage_index,
            "module_summary_index": module_summary_index,
            "module_centrality_index": module_centrality_index,
            "symbol_centrality_index": symbol_centrality_index,
            "project_hotspots": project_hotspots,
            "file_priority_index": file_priority_index,
            "priority_ranking": priority_ranking,
        },
        "collection_config": build_collection_config(config),
        "files": files_payload,
        "symbol_index": symbol_index,
        "import_graph": import_graph,
        "call_edges": call_edges,
        "keyword_index": {},
        "semantic_roles": {
            record["path"]: {
                "roles": record["semantic_roles"],
                "primary_role": record["primary_role"],
                "secondary_roles": record["secondary_roles"],
                "confidence": record["role_confidence"],
                "evidence_terms": record["semantic_hints"],
            }
            for record in files_payload
        },
        "qt_signal_map": qt_signal_map,
        "attribute_state_map": attribute_state_map,
        "object_ownership": object_ownership,
        "execution_chains": execution_chains,
        "subsystems": subsystems,
        "symbol_summaries": symbol_summaries,
        "snippet_index": snippet_index,
        "duplicate_symbols": duplicate_symbols,
        "test_links": test_links,
        "errors": errors,
    }

    safe_json_dump(output, output_path)
    return output

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from collector_ast import parse_python_file
from collector_centrality import (
    build_module_centrality_index,
    build_symbol_centrality_index,
    build_top_project_hotspots,
)
from collector_chains import build_execution_chains
from collector_config import CollectorConfig
from collector_coverage import collect_coverage_for_file
from collector_duplicates import find_duplicate_symbols
from collector_git import collect_git_metadata_for_file
from collector_insights import (
    get_entry_chain_summary,
    get_project_hotspot_summary,
    get_top_central_symbols,
    get_top_priority_files,
)
from collector_module_summary import build_module_responsibility_summary
from collector_output import build_collection_config, build_collector_info
from collector_ownership import build_object_ownership_map
from collector_priority import build_file_priority_index, build_priority_ranking
from collector_qt import extract_qt_signal_map
from collector_roles import summarize_file_semantics, summarize_symbol_semantics
from collector_state import build_attribute_state_map
from collector_subsystems import build_subsystem_summaries
from collector_tests import link_tests_to_sources
from collector_utils import normalize_path, safe_json_dump
from collector_walker import walk_python_files_filtered


def _build_coverage_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("coverage_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("git_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def _build_module_summary_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("module_responsibility_summary", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        git_metadata = collect_git_metadata_for_file(root, path)
        coverage_metadata = collect_coverage_for_file(root, path)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def parse_python_source_with_warnings(source: str) -> tuple[ast.AST | None, str | None, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    captured: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    try:
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as records:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            tree = ast.parse(source)

        for item in records:
            captured.append(
                {
                    "category": getattr(item.category, "__name__", ""),
                    "message": str(item.message),
                    "line": getattr(item, "lineno", None),
                }
            )

        return tree, None, captured

    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc), captured


def normalize_file_warning_records(path: Path, warning_records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for item in warning_records:
        normalized.append(
            {
                "file": str(path),
                "category": item.get("category", ""),
                "message": item.get("message", ""),
                "line": item.get("line"),
            }
        )

    return normalized

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_warnings import parse_python_source_with_warnings


class TestWarningCapture(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_invalid_escape_sequence_warning_is_captured(self) -> None:
        source = 'value = "C:\\example\\new\\eeg\\test"\n'
        _tree, error, warnings_list = parse_python_source_with_warnings(source)

        self.assertIsNone(error)
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(warnings_list, list))

    def test_valid_source_returns_no_parse_error(self) -> None:
        source = "x = 1\ny = x + 2\n"
        tree, error, warnings_list = parse_python_source_with_warnings(source)

        self.assertIsNotNone(tree)
        self.assertIsNone(error)
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(warnings_list, list))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from collector_ast import parse_python_file
from collector_centrality import (
    build_module_centrality_index,
    build_symbol_centrality_index,
    build_top_project_hotspots,
)
from collector_chains import build_execution_chains
from collector_config import CollectorConfig
from collector_coverage import collect_coverage_for_file
from collector_duplicates import find_duplicate_symbols
from collector_git import collect_git_metadata_for_file
from collector_insights import (
    get_entry_chain_summary,
    get_project_hotspot_summary,
    get_top_central_symbols,
    get_top_priority_files,
)
from collector_module_summary import build_module_responsibility_summary
from collector_output import build_collection_config, build_collector_info
from collector_ownership import build_object_ownership_map
from collector_priority import build_file_priority_index, build_priority_ranking
from collector_qt import extract_qt_signal_map
from collector_roles import summarize_file_semantics, summarize_symbol_semantics
from collector_state import build_attribute_state_map
from collector_subsystems import build_subsystem_summaries
from collector_tests import link_tests_to_sources
from collector_utils import normalize_path, safe_json_dump
from collector_walker import walk_python_files_filtered
from collector_warnings import normalize_file_warning_records


def _build_warning_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("parse_warnings", [])
        for record in files_payload
        if record.get("parse_warnings")
    }


def _count_total_warnings(files_payload: list[dict]) -> int:
    total = 0
    for record in files_payload:
        total += len(record.get("parse_warnings", []))
    return total


def _build_coverage_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("coverage_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("git_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def _build_module_summary_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("module_responsibility_summary", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }

    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        git_metadata = collect_git_metadata_for_file(root, path)
        coverage_metadata = collect_coverage_for_file(root, path)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        parse_warnings = []
        if parsed is not None:
            parse_warnings = normalize_file_warning_records(

                parsed.get("parse_warnings", []),
            )

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

            ),

        }

            file_record
        )

    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)

    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)
