from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow
from collector_docstrings import build_docstring_summary
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text
from collector_warnings import parse_python_source_with_warnings


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(
    source: str,
    tree: ast.AST | None,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    if tree is not None:
        try:
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                    value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                    if value:
                        strings.append(value)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    docstring = _get_docstring(node)
    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": docstring,
        "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(docstring),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
        "data_flow": build_data_flow(node),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree, parse_warning_error, parse_warnings = parse_python_source_with_warnings(source)
        if parse_warning_error is not None or tree is None:
            return None, parse_warning_error
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source, tree)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]
            class_docstring = _get_docstring(node)

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": class_docstring,
                    "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(class_docstring),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "module_docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(module_docstring),
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "parse_warnings": parse_warnings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _lower_items(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    for value in values:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            out.append(value.lower())
    return out


def classify_file_bucket(file_record: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    path = str(file_record.get("path", "")).lower()
    module_name = str(file_record.get("module_name", "")).lower()
    imports = _lower_items(file_record.get("imports", []))
    semantic_roles = _lower_items(file_record.get("semantic_roles", []))
    primary_role = str(file_record.get("primary_role", "")).lower()
    summary = str(file_record.get("summary", "")).lower()

    combined_text = " ".join(
        [
            path,
            module_name,
            " ".join(imports),
            " ".join(semantic_roles),
            primary_role,
            summary,
        ]
    )

    if "/tests/" in path or path.startswith("tests/") or module_name.endswith(".tests"):
        return "tests"

    if "legacy" in combined_text or "deprecated" in combined_text or "old_" in path:
        return "legacy"

    if "qt" in combined_text or "pyside" in combined_text or "ui" in semantic_roles:
        return "ui_qt"

    if "runtime" in combined_text or "trace" in combined_text or "monitor" in combined_text:
        return "runtime_tracing"

    if "collector" in combined_text or "reasoner" in combined_text or "index" in combined_text:
        return "collector_indexing"

    if "eeg" in combined_text or "neuro" in combined_text:
        return "eeg_domain"

    if "util" in combined_text or "config" in combined_text or "helper" in combined_text:
        return "infrastructure_utils"

    return "general"


def build_bucket_index(files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    bucket_index: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = str(file_record.get("path", ""))
        bucket = classify_file_bucket(file_record)
        file_record["subsystem_bucket"] = bucket

        if bucket not in bucket_index:
            bucket_index[bucket] = []
        bucket_index[bucket].append(path)

    for bucket_name in bucket_index:
        bucket_index[bucket_name] = sorted(set(bucket_index[bucket_name]))

    return dict(sorted(bucket_index.items()))


def build_bucket_summary(files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    summary: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        bucket = str(file_record.get("subsystem_bucket") or classify_file_bucket(file_record))
        path = str(file_record.get("path", ""))
        primary_role = str(file_record.get("primary_role", ""))

        if bucket not in summary:
            summary[bucket] = {
                "file_count": 0,
                "files": [],
                "primary_roles": {},
            }

        summary[bucket]["file_count"] += 1
        summary[bucket]["files"].append(path)

        if primary_role:
            roles = summary[bucket]["primary_roles"]
            roles[primary_role] = roles.get(primary_role, 0) + 1

    for bucket_name, bucket_payload in summary.items():
        bucket_payload["files"] = sorted(set(bucket_payload["files"]))
        bucket_payload["primary_roles"] = dict(
            sorted(
                bucket_payload["primary_roles"].items(),
                key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
            )
        )

    return dict(sorted(summary.items()))

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_float(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def _safe_int(value: Any) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def build_bucket_hotspots(
    bucket_summary: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    module_centrality_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 10,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for bucket_name, bucket_payload in bucket_summary.items():
        files = bucket_payload.get("files", [])
        centrality_values: list[float] = []

        for file_path in files:
            module_payload = module_centrality_index.get(file_path, {})
            centrality_values.append(
                _safe_float(module_payload.get("centrality_score", 0.0))
            )

        total_centrality = sum(centrality_values)
        average_centrality = (
            total_centrality / len(centrality_values)
            if centrality_values
            else 0.0
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "bucket": bucket_name,
                "file_count": len(files),
                "total_centrality": round(total_centrality, 4),
                "average_centrality": round(average_centrality, 4),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -_safe_float(item.get("total_centrality", 0.0)),
            -_safe_float(item.get("average_centrality", 0.0)),
            item.get("bucket", ""),
        )
    )
    return rows[:limit]


def build_bucket_priority_summary(
    bucket_summary: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    file_priority_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for bucket_name, bucket_payload in bucket_summary.items():
        files = bucket_payload.get("files", [])
        scores: list[float] = []

        for file_path in files:
            priority_payload = file_priority_index.get(file_path, {})
            scores.append(_safe_float(priority_payload.get("priority_score", 0.0)))

        output[bucket_name] = {
            "file_count": len(files),
            "total_priority_score": round(sum(scores), 4),
            "average_priority_score": round(
                (sum(scores) / len(scores)) if scores else 0.0,
                4,
            ),
            "top_files": sorted(
                files,
                key=lambda path: -_safe_float(
                    file_priority_index.get(path, {}).get("priority_score", 0.0)
                ),
            )[:10],
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_bucket_warning_summary(
    bucket_summary: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    warning_index: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for bucket_name, bucket_payload in bucket_summary.items():
        files = bucket_payload.get("files", [])
        warning_count = 0
        files_with_warnings: list[str] = []

        for file_path in files:
            warning_items = warning_index.get(file_path, [])
            if warning_items:
                files_with_warnings.append(file_path)
                warning_count += len(warning_items)

        output[bucket_name] = {
            "file_count": len(files),
            "warning_file_count": len(files_with_warnings),
            "warning_count": warning_count,
            "files_with_warnings": sorted(files_with_warnings),
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_bucket_insights(
    bucket_summary: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    module_centrality_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    file_priority_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    warning_index: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    bucket_hotspots = build_bucket_hotspots(
        bucket_summary,
        module_centrality_index,
        limit=10,
    )
    bucket_priority_summary = build_bucket_priority_summary(
        bucket_summary,
        file_priority_index,
    )
    bucket_warning_summary = build_bucket_warning_summary(
        bucket_summary,
        warning_index,
    )

    hottest_bucket = bucket_hotspots[0]["bucket"] if bucket_hotspots else ""
    noisiest_bucket = ""
    highest_warning_count = -1

    for bucket_name, payload in bucket_warning_summary.items():
        warning_count = _safe_int(payload.get("warning_count", 0))
        if warning_count > highest_warning_count:
            highest_warning_count = warning_count
            noisiest_bucket = bucket_name

    return {
        "bucket_hotspots": bucket_hotspots,
        "bucket_priority_summary": bucket_priority_summary,
        "bucket_warning_summary": bucket_warning_summary,
        "top_bucket_overview": {
            "hottest_bucket": hottest_bucket,
            "noisiest_bucket": noisiest_bucket,
        },
    }

def _build_warning_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("parse_warnings", {})
        for record in files_payload
        if record.get("parse_warnings")
    }


def _count_total_warnings(files_payload: list[dict]) -> int:
    total = 0
    for record in files_payload:
        total += len(record.get("parse_warnings", []))
    return total


def _build_coverage_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("coverage_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("git_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def _build_module_summary_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("module_responsibility_summary", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        git_metadata = collect_git_metadata_for_file(root, path)
        coverage_metadata = collect_coverage_for_file(root, path)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        parse_warnings = []
        if parsed is not None:
            parse_warnings = normalize_file_warning_records(
                Path(rel_path),
                parsed.get("parse_warnings", []),
            )

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

        file_record = {
            "path": rel_path,
            "module_name": module_name,
            "imports": parsed["imports"],
            "classes": parsed["classes"],
            "functions": parsed["functions"],
            "docstring": docstring,
            "comments": comments,
            "strings": strings,
            "entry_markers": entry_markers,
            "ui_keyword_hits": [],
            "eeg_keyword_hits": [],
            "semantic_hints": semantic["evidence_terms"],
            "semantic_roles": semantic["roles"],
            "primary_role": semantic["primary_role"],
            "secondary_roles": semantic["secondary_roles"],
            "role_confidence": semantic["confidence"],
            "summary": (
                f"{semantic['primary_role']} file"
                if semantic["primary_role"]
                else "general python module"
            ),
            "source": parsed["source"],
            "git_metadata": git_metadata,
            "coverage_metadata": coverage_metadata,
            "parse_warnings": parse_warnings,
        }

        file_record["module_responsibility_summary"] = build_module_responsibility_summary(
            file_record
        )

        files_payload.append(file_record)

    symbol_index = _build_symbol_index(files_payload)
    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)
    call_edges = _build_call_edges(files_payload)
    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)
    object_ownership = build_object_ownership_map(files_payload)
    execution_chains = build_execution_chains(files_payload, entry_files)
    subsystems = build_subsystem_summaries(files_payload)
    symbol_summaries = _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload)
    snippet_index = _build_snippet_index(files_payload, config.max_snippet_lines)
    duplicate_symbols = find_duplicate_symbols(files_payload)
    test_links = link_tests_to_sources(files_payload)
    bucket_index = build_bucket_index(files_payload)
    bucket_summary = build_bucket_summary(files_payload)


    module_centrality_index = build_module_centrality_index(
        import_graph,
        call_edges,
        symbol_index,
    )
    symbol_centrality_index = build_symbol_centrality_index(call_edges)
    project_hotspots = build_top_project_hotspots(
        module_centrality_index,
        symbol_centrality_index,
        limit=25,
    )

    file_priority_index = build_file_priority_index(
        files_payload,
        module_centrality_index,
    )
    priority_ranking = build_priority_ranking(file_priority_index, limit=50)

    insights_payload_base = {
        "project_summary": {
            "project_root": str(root),
            "python_file_count": len(files_payload),
            "entry_file_count": len(entry_files),
            "entry_files": sorted(set(entry_files)),
            "parse_error_count": len(errors),
        },
        "execution_chains": execution_chains,
        "project_hotspots": project_hotspots,
        "symbol_centrality_index": symbol_centrality_index,
        "module_centrality_index": module_centrality_index,
        "file_priority_index": file_priority_index,
        "priority_ranking": priority_ranking,
    }

    collector_insights = {

        ),

    git_metadata_index = _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload)
    coverage_index = _build_coverage_index(files_payload)
    module_summary_index = _build_module_summary_index(files_payload)

    warning_index = _build_warning_index(files_payload)
    total_warning_count = _count_total_warnings(files_payload)

    bucket_insights = build_bucket_insights(
        bucket_summary,
        module_centrality_index,

    output = {
        "collector_info": build_collector_info(root),
        "warning_index": warning_index,

        "project_summary": {

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_chain_step(step: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(step, dict):
        return {}
    return {
        "file": str(step.get("file", "") or ""),
        "symbol": str(step.get("symbol", "") or ""),
        "line": step.get("line"),
    }


def build_entry_bucket_flows(
    execution_chains: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for entry_file, chains in execution_chains.items():
        chain_list = chains if isinstance(chains, list) else []
        bucket_sequences: list[list[str]] = []
        bucket_frequency: dict[str, int] = {}
        first_bucket_frequency: dict[str, int] = {}

        for chain in chain_list:
            steps = chain if isinstance(chain, list) else []
            sequence: list[str] = []

            for raw_step in steps:
                step = _normalize_chain_step(raw_step)
                file_path = step.get("file", "")
                if not file_path:
                    continue

                bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(file_path, files_payload)

                if not sequence or sequence[-1] != bucket:
                    sequence.append(bucket)

                bucket_frequency[bucket] = bucket_frequency.get(bucket, 0) + 1

            if sequence:
                bucket_sequences.append(sequence)
                first_bucket = sequence[0]
                first_bucket_frequency[first_bucket] = (
                    first_bucket_frequency.get(first_bucket, 0) + 1
                )

        unique_buckets = sorted(
            {
                bucket
                for sequence in bucket_sequences
                for bucket in sequence
            }
        )

        output[entry_file] = {
            "chain_count": len(bucket_sequences),
            "unique_buckets": unique_buckets,
            "bucket_sequences": bucket_sequences,
            "bucket_frequency": dict(
                sorted(
                    bucket_frequency.items(),
                    key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
                )
            ),
            "first_bucket_frequency": dict(
                sorted(
                    first_bucket_frequency.items(),
                    key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
                )
            ),
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(
    entry_bucket_flows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for entry_file, payload in entry_bucket_flows.items():
        first_bucket_frequency = payload.get("first_bucket_frequency", {})
        bucket_frequency = payload.get("bucket_frequency", {})
        unique_buckets = payload.get("unique_buckets", [])

        dominant_first_bucket = ""
        if first_bucket_frequency:
            dominant_first_bucket = next(iter(first_bucket_frequency.keys()))

        dominant_bucket = ""
        if bucket_frequency:
            dominant_bucket = next(iter(bucket_frequency.keys()))

        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "entry_file": entry_file,
                "chain_count": int(payload.get("chain_count", 0)),
                "unique_bucket_count": len(unique_buckets),
                "dominant_first_bucket": dominant_first_bucket,
                "dominant_bucket": dominant_bucket,
                "unique_buckets": unique_buckets,
            }
        )

    summary_rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("chain_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("unique_bucket_count", 0)),
            item.get("entry_file", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "entry_count": len(summary_rows),
        "entries": summary_rows,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_entry_bucket_flows import (
    build_entry_bucket_flow_summary,
    build_entry_bucket_flows,
)


class EntryBucketFlowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_build_entry_bucket_flows(self) -> None:
        files_payload = [
            {"path": "app_main.py", "subsystem_bucket": "ui_qt"},
            {"path": "runtime/trace.py", "subsystem_bucket": "runtime_tracing"},
            {"path": "collector_main.py", "subsystem_bucket": "collector_indexing"},
        ]

        execution_chains = {
            "app_main.py": [
                [
                    {"file": "app_main.py", "symbol": "main"},
                    {"file": "runtime/trace.py", "symbol": "start_trace"},
                    {"file": "collector_main.py", "symbol": "run_collector"},
                ],
                [
                    {"file": "app_main.py", "symbol": "main"},
                    {"file": "runtime/trace.py", "symbol": "save_trace"},
                ],
            ]
        }

        output = build_entry_bucket_flows(execution_chains, files_payload)

        self.assertIn("app_main.py", output)
        self.assertEqual(output["app_main.py"]["chain_count"], 2)
        self.assertIn("ui_qt", output["app_main.py"]["unique_buckets"])
        self.assertIn("runtime_tracing", output["app_main.py"]["unique_buckets"])

    def test_build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(self) -> None:
        entry_bucket_flows = {
            "app_main.py": {
                "chain_count": 2,
                "unique_buckets": ["ui_qt", "runtime_tracing", "collector_indexing"],
                "bucket_sequences": [
                    ["ui_qt", "runtime_tracing", "collector_indexing"],
                    ["ui_qt", "runtime_tracing"],
                ],
                "bucket_frequency": {
                    "ui_qt": 2,
                    "runtime_tracing": 2,
                    "collector_indexing": 1,
                },
                "first_bucket_frequency": {
                    "ui_qt": 2,
                },
            }
        }

        summary = build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(entry_bucket_flows)

        self.assertEqual(summary["entry_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(summary["entries"][0]["entry_file"], "app_main.py")
        self.assertEqual(summary["entries"][0]["dominant_first_bucket"], "ui_qt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Use this full corrected collector_entry_bucket_flows.py:

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_chain_step(step: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(step, dict):
        return {}
    return {
        "file": str(step.get("file", "") or ""),
        "symbol": str(step.get("symbol", "") or ""),
        "line": step.get("line"),
        "step": step.get("step"),
        "why": str(step.get("why", "") or ""),
    }


def build_entry_bucket_flows(
    execution_chains: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for chain_name, raw_steps in execution_chains.items():
        steps = raw_steps if isinstance(raw_steps, list) else []

        bucket_sequence: list[str] = []
        bucket_frequency: dict[str, int] = {}
        file_sequence: list[str] = []
        unique_files: set[str] = set()

        for raw_step in steps:
            step = _normalize_chain_step(raw_step)
            file_path = step.get("file", "")
            if not file_path:
                continue

            unique_files.add(file_path)
            file_sequence.append(file_path)

            bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(file_path, files_payload)

            if not bucket_sequence or bucket_sequence[-1] != bucket:
                bucket_sequence.append(bucket)

            bucket_frequency[bucket] = bucket_frequency.get(bucket, 0) + 1

        first_bucket = bucket_sequence[0] if bucket_sequence else ""
        dominant_bucket = ""
        if bucket_frequency:
            dominant_bucket = sorted(
                bucket_frequency.items(),
                key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
            )[0][0]

        output[str(chain_name)] = {
            "chain_name": str(chain_name),
            "step_count": len(steps),
            "file_count": len(unique_files),
            "bucket_sequence": bucket_sequence,
            "unique_buckets": sorted(set(bucket_sequence)),
            "bucket_frequency": dict(
                sorted(
                    bucket_frequency.items(),
                    key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
                )
            ),
            "first_bucket": first_bucket,
            "dominant_bucket": dominant_bucket,
            "first_file": file_sequence[0] if file_sequence else "",
            "sample_files": file_sequence[:15],
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(
    entry_bucket_flows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for chain_name, payload in entry_bucket_flows.items():
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "chain_name": chain_name,
                "step_count": int(payload.get("step_count", 0)),
                "file_count": int(payload.get("file_count", 0)),
                "unique_bucket_count": len(payload.get("unique_buckets", [])),
                "first_bucket": str(payload.get("first_bucket", "")),
                "dominant_bucket": str(payload.get("dominant_bucket", "")),
                "first_file": str(payload.get("first_file", "")),
                "unique_buckets": payload.get("unique_buckets", []),
            }
        )

    summary_rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("step_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("unique_bucket_count", 0)),
            item.get("chain_name", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "entry_count": len(summary_rows),
        "entries": summary_rows,
    }

                {"step": 2, "file": "runtime/trace.py", "symbol": "start_trace"},
                {"step": 3, "file": "collector_main.py", "symbol": "run_collector"},
            ]
        }

        output = build_entry_bucket_flows(execution_chains, files_payload)

        self.assertEqual(output["startup_chain"]["step_count"], 3)

                "first_file": "app_main.py",
                "sample_files": [
                    "app_main.py",
                    "runtime/trace.py",
                    "collector_main.py",
                ],
            }
        }

        summary = build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(entry_bucket_flows)

        self.assertEqual(summary["entry_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(summary["entries"][0]["chain_name"], "startup_chain")
        self.assertEqual(summary["entries"][0]["first_bucket"], "ui_qt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Update collector_entry_bucket_flows.py

Add near the top:

NOISE_BUCKETS = {"tests", "legacy"}

Add helpers:

def _sorted_frequency_items(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    return sorted(
        bucket_frequency.items(),
        key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
    )


def _pick_dominant_bucket(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    if not bucket_frequency:
        return ""
    return _sorted_frequency_items(bucket_frequency)[0][0]


def _pick_dominant_bucket_clean(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    clean_frequency = {
        bucket: count
        for bucket, count in bucket_frequency.items()
        if bucket not in NOISE_BUCKETS
    }
    if clean_frequency:
        return _pick_dominant_bucket(clean_frequency)
    return _pick_dominant_bucket(bucket_frequency)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

NOISE_BUCKETS = {"tests", "legacy"}

def _sorted_frequency_items(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    return sorted(
        bucket_frequency.items(),
        key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
    )


def _pick_dominant_bucket(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    if not bucket_frequency:
        return ""
    return _sorted_frequency_items(bucket_frequency)[0][0]


def _pick_dominant_bucket_clean(bucket_frequency: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    clean_frequency = {
        bucket: count
        for bucket, count in bucket_frequency.items()
        if bucket not in NOISE_BUCKETS
    }
    if clean_frequency:
        return _pick_dominant_bucket(clean_frequency)
    return _pick_dominant_bucket(bucket_frequency)


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_chain_step(step: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(step, dict):
        return {}
    return {
        "file": str(step.get("file", "") or ""),
        "symbol": str(step.get("symbol", "") or ""),
        "line": step.get("line"),
        "step": step.get("step"),
        "why": str(step.get("why", "") or ""),
    }


def build_entry_bucket_flows(
    execution_chains: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for chain_name, raw_steps in execution_chains.items():
        steps = raw_steps if isinstance(raw_steps, list) else []

        bucket_sequence: list[str] = []
        bucket_frequency: dict[str, int] = {}
        file_sequence: list[str] = []
        unique_files: set[str] = set()

        for raw_step in steps:
            step = _normalize_chain_step(raw_step)
            file_path = step.get("file", "")
            if not file_path:
                continue

            unique_files.add(file_path)
            file_sequence.append(file_path)

            bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(file_path, files_payload)

            if not bucket_sequence or bucket_sequence[-1] != bucket:
                bucket_sequence.append(bucket)

            bucket_frequency[bucket] = bucket_frequency.get(bucket, 0) + 1

        first_bucket = bucket_sequence[0] if bucket_sequence else ""

        dominant_bucket = _pick_dominant_bucket(bucket_frequency)
        dominant_bucket_clean = _pick_dominant_bucket_clean(bucket_frequency)

        noise_buckets_present = sorted(
            [bucket for bucket in bucket_frequency.keys() if bucket in NOISE_BUCKETS]
        )

        build_entry_bucket_flow_summary
        
        output[str(chain_name)] = {
            "chain_name": str(chain_name),
            "step_count": len(steps),
            "file_count": len(unique_files),
            "bucket_sequence": bucket_sequence,
            "unique_buckets": sorted(set(bucket_sequence)),
            "bucket_frequency": dict(
                sorted(
                    bucket_frequency.items(),
                    key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
                )
            ),
            "first_bucket": first_bucket,
            "dominant_bucket": dominant_bucket,
            "dominant_bucket_clean": dominant_bucket_clean,
            "noise_buckets_present": noise_buckets_present,
            "noise_bucket_count": len(noise_buckets_present),
            "first_file": file_sequence[0] if file_sequence else "",
            "sample_files": file_sequence[:15],
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_entry_bucket_flow_summary(
    entry_bucket_flows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for chain_name, payload in entry_bucket_flows.items():
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "chain_name": chain_name,
                "step_count": int(payload.get("step_count", 0)),
                "file_count": int(payload.get("file_count", 0)),
                "unique_bucket_count": len(payload.get("unique_buckets", [])),
                "first_bucket": str(payload.get("first_bucket", "")),
                "dominant_bucket": str(payload.get("dominant_bucket", "")),
                "first_file": str(payload.get("first_file", "")),
                "unique_buckets": payload.get("unique_buckets", []),
            }
        )

    summary_rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("step_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("unique_bucket_count", 0)),
            item.get("chain_name", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "entry_count": len(summary_rows),
        "entries": summary_rows,
    }

            unique_files.add(file_path)

            bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(file_path, files_payload)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_signal_record(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "file": str(record.get("file", "") or ""),
        "widget": str(record.get("widget", "") or ""),
        "signal": str(record.get("signal", "") or ""),
        "handler": str(record.get("handler", "") or ""),
        "line": record.get("line"),
    }


def _resolve_handler_target(
    handler_name: str,
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = symbol_index.get(handler_name, {})
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "symbol": handler_name,
        "file": str(payload.get("file", "") or ""),
        "line": payload.get("line"),
        "kind": str(payload.get("kind", "") or ""),
    }


def build_ui_action_index(
    qt_signal_map: dict[str, Any],
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for _, raw_records in qt_signal_map.items():
        records = raw_records if isinstance(raw_records, list) else []

        for raw_record in records:
            record = _normalize_signal_record(raw_record)
            widget = record.get("widget", "")
            signal = record.get("signal", "")
            handler = record.get("handler", "")
            source_file = record.get("file", "")

            if not signal and not handler:
                continue

            action_key = f"{widget}::{signal}::{handler}".strip(":")
            if not action_key:
                continue

            target = _resolve_handler_target(handler, symbol_index)
            target_file = target.get("file", "")
            target_bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(target_file, files_payload) if target_file else "general"

            if action_key not in action_index:
                action_index[action_key] = {
                    "action_key": action_key,
                    "widget": widget,
                    "signal": signal,
                    "handler": handler,
                    "source_files": [],
                    "target_symbols": [],
                    "target_files": [],
                    "target_buckets": [],
                    "records": [],
                }

            item = action_index[action_key]

            if source_file and source_file not in item["source_files"]:
                item["source_files"].append(source_file)

            if handler and handler not in item["target_symbols"]:
                item["target_symbols"].append(handler)

            if target_file and target_file not in item["target_files"]:
                item["target_files"].append(target_file)

            if target_bucket and target_bucket not in item["target_buckets"]:
                item["target_buckets"].append(target_bucket)

            item["records"].append(
                {
                    "source_file": source_file,
                    "widget": widget,
                    "signal": signal,
                    "handler": handler,
                    "target_file": target_file,
                    "target_line": target.get("line"),
                    "target_kind": target.get("kind", ""),
                    "target_bucket": target_bucket,
                    "line": record.get("line"),
                }
            )

    return dict(sorted(action_index.items()))


def build_ui_action_summary(
    ui_action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for action_key, payload in ui_action_index.items():
        rows.append(
            {
                "action_key": action_key,
                "widget": str(payload.get("widget", "")),
                "signal": str(payload.get("signal", "")),
                "handler": str(payload.get("handler", "")),
                "source_file_count": len(payload.get("source_files", [])),
                "target_symbol_count": len(payload.get("target_symbols", [])),
                "target_file_count": len(payload.get("target_files", [])),
                "target_bucket_count": len(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "target_buckets": sorted(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("target_bucket_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("target_file_count", 0)),
            item.get("action_key", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "action_count": len(rows),
        "actions": rows,
    }


def build_ui_action_hotspots(
    ui_action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 20,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    hotspots: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for action_key, payload in ui_action_index.items():
        hotspots.append(
            {
                "action_key": action_key,
                "widget": str(payload.get("widget", "")),
                "signal": str(payload.get("signal", "")),
                "handler": str(payload.get("handler", "")),
                "target_file_count": len(payload.get("target_files", [])),
                "target_bucket_count": len(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "target_buckets": sorted(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
            }
        )

    hotspots.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("target_bucket_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("target_file_count", 0)),
            item.get("action_key", ""),
        )
    )

    return hotspots[:limit]

class UIActionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_build_ui_action_index(self) -> None:
        qt_signal_map = {
            "main_window.py": [
                {
                    "file": "main_window.py",
                    "widget": "save_button",
                    "signal": "clicked",
                    "handler": "MainWindow.save_file",
                    "line": 10,
                }
            ]
        }

        symbol_index = {
            "MainWindow.save_file": {
                "file": "controllers/save_controller.py",
                "line": 25,
                "kind": "method",
            }
        }

        files_payload = [
            {
                "path": "controllers/save_controller.py",
                "subsystem_bucket": "ui_qt",
            }
        ]

        output = build_ui_action_index(qt_signal_map, symbol_index, files_payload)

        self.assertIn("save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file", output)
        item = output["save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file"]
        self.assertEqual(item["target_files"], ["controllers/save_controller.py"])
        self.assertEqual(item["target_buckets"], ["ui_qt"])

    def test_build_ui_action_summary(self) -> None:
        ui_action_index = {
            "save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file": {
                "action_key": "save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file",
                "widget": "save_button",
                "signal": "clicked",
                "handler": "MainWindow.save_file",
                "source_files": ["main_window.py"],
                "target_symbols": ["MainWindow.save_file"],
                "target_files": ["controllers/save_controller.py"],
                "target_buckets": ["ui_qt"],
                "records": [],
            }
        }

        summary = build_ui_action_summary(ui_action_index)
        self.assertEqual(summary["action_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(summary["actions"][0]["widget"], "save_button")

    def test_build_ui_action_hotspots(self) -> None:
        ui_action_index = {
            "save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file": {
                "action_key": "save_button::clicked::MainWindow.save_file",
                "widget": "save_button",
                "signal": "clicked",
                "handler": "MainWindow.save_file",
                "source_files": ["main_window.py"],
                "target_symbols": ["MainWindow.save_file"],
                "target_files": ["controllers/save_controller.py"],
                "target_buckets": ["ui_qt", "runtime_tracing"],
                "records": [],
            }
        }

        hotspots = build_ui_action_hotspots(ui_action_index, limit=10)
        self.assertEqual(len(hotspots), 1)
        self.assertEqual(hotspots[0]["target_bucket_count"], 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:

            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"

    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "file": str(record.get("file", "") or ""),
        "widget": str(record.get("widget", "") or ""),
        "signal": str(record.get("signal", "") or ""),
        "handler": str(record.get("handler", "") or ""),
        "line": record.get("line"),
    }


def _resolve_handler_target(
    handler_name: str,
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = symbol_index.get(handler_name, {})
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "symbol": handler_name,
        "file": str(payload.get("file", "") or ""),
        "line": payload.get("line"),
        "kind": str(payload.get("kind", "") or ""),
    }


def build_ui_action_index(
    qt_signal_map: dict[str, Any],
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for _, raw_records in qt_signal_map.items():
        records = raw_records if isinstance(raw_records, list) else []

        for raw_record in records:
            record = _normalize_signal_record(raw_record)
            widget = record.get("widget", "")
            signal = record.get("signal", "")
            handler = record.get("handler", "")
            source_file = record.get("file", "")

            if not signal and not handler:
                continue

            action_key = f"{widget}::{signal}::{handler}".strip(":")
            if not action_key:
                continue

            target = _resolve_handler_target(handler, symbol_index)
            target_file = target.get("file", "")
            target_bucket = (
                _safe_bucket_for_file(target_file, files_payload)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_signal_record(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "file": str(record.get("file", "") or ""),
        "widget": str(record.get("widget", "") or ""),
        "signal": str(record.get("signal", "") or ""),
        "handler": str(record.get("handler", "") or ""),
        "line": record.get("line"),
    }


def _resolve_handler_target(
    handler_name: str,
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = symbol_index.get(handler_name, {})
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "symbol": handler_name,
        "file": str(payload.get("file", "") or ""),
        "line": payload.get("line"),
        "kind": str(payload.get("kind", "") or ""),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _safe_bucket_for_file(
    file_path: str,
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> str:
    for record in files_payload:
        if str(record.get("path", "")) == file_path:
            bucket = str(record.get("subsystem_bucket", "")).strip()
            if bucket:
                return bucket
            break
    return "general"


def _normalize_signal_record(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return {}

    source_file = str(
        record.get("source_file", "")
        or record.get("file", "")
        or ""
    )
    source_symbol = str(
        record.get("source_symbol", "")
        or record.get("widget", "")
        or ""
    )
    signal_name = str(
        record.get("signal_name", "")
        or record.get("signal", "")
        or ""
    )
    target = str(
        record.get("target", "")
        or record.get("handler", "")
        or ""
    )

    return {
        "source_file": source_file,
        "source_symbol": source_symbol,
        "signal_name": signal_name,
        "target": target,
        "line": record.get("line"),
        "confidence": record.get("confidence"),
    }


def _resolve_target_symbol(
    target_name: str,
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not target_name or target_name == "unknown":
        return {}

    payload = symbol_index.get(target_name, {})
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {}

    return {
        "symbol": target_name,
        "file": str(payload.get("file", "") or ""),
        "line": payload.get("line"),
        "kind": str(payload.get("kind", "") or ""),
    }


def _iter_signal_records(qt_signal_map: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    if isinstance(qt_signal_map, list):
        for item in qt_signal_map:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                records.append(item)
        return records

    if isinstance(qt_signal_map, dict):
        for _, raw_records in qt_signal_map.items():
            if isinstance(raw_records, list):
                for item in raw_records:
                    if isinstance(item, dict):
                        records.append(item)
            elif isinstance(raw_records, dict):
                records.append(raw_records)

    return records


def build_ui_action_index(
    qt_signal_map: Any,
    symbol_index: dict[str, Any],
    files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for raw_record in _iter_signal_records(qt_signal_map):
        record = _normalize_signal_record(raw_record)

        source_file = record.get("source_file", "")
        source_symbol = record.get("source_symbol", "")
        signal_name = record.get("signal_name", "")
        target_name = record.get("target", "")

        if not source_symbol and not signal_name and not target_name:
            continue

        action_key = f"{source_symbol}::{signal_name}::{target_name}".strip(":")
        if not action_key:
            continue

        target_payload = _resolve_target_symbol(target_name, symbol_index)
        target_file = target_payload.get("file", "")
        target_bucket = (
            _safe_bucket_for_file(target_file, files_payload)
            if target_file
            else ""
        )

        source_bucket = _safe_bucket_for_file(source_file, files_payload) if source_file else "general"

        if action_key not in action_index:
            action_index[action_key] = {
                "action_key": action_key,
                "source_symbol": source_symbol,
                "signal_name": signal_name,
                "target": target_name,
                "source_files": [],
                "source_buckets": [],
                "target_symbols": [],
                "target_files": [],
                "target_buckets": [],
                "records": [],
            }

        item = action_index[action_key]

        if source_file and source_file not in item["source_files"]:
            item["source_files"].append(source_file)

        if source_bucket and source_bucket not in item["source_buckets"]:
            item["source_buckets"].append(source_bucket)

        if target_name and target_name not in item["target_symbols"]:
            item["target_symbols"].append(target_name)

        if target_file and target_file not in item["target_files"]:
            item["target_files"].append(target_file)

        if target_bucket and target_bucket not in item["target_buckets"]:
            item["target_buckets"].append(target_bucket)

        item["records"].append(
            {
                "source_file": source_file,
                "source_symbol": source_symbol,
                "signal_name": signal_name,
                "target": target_name,
                "target_file": target_file,
                "target_line": target_payload.get("line"),
                "target_kind": target_payload.get("kind", ""),
                "target_bucket": target_bucket,
                "source_bucket": source_bucket,
                "line": record.get("line"),
                "confidence": record.get("confidence"),
            }
        )

    return dict(sorted(action_index.items()))


def build_ui_action_summary(
    ui_action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for action_key, payload in ui_action_index.items():
        rows.append(
            {
                "action_key": action_key,
                "source_symbol": str(payload.get("source_symbol", "")),
                "signal_name": str(payload.get("signal_name", "")),
                "target": str(payload.get("target", "")),
                "source_file_count": len(payload.get("source_files", [])),
                "source_bucket_count": len(payload.get("source_buckets", [])),
                "target_symbol_count": len(payload.get("target_symbols", [])),
                "target_file_count": len(payload.get("target_files", [])),
                "target_bucket_count": len(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "source_buckets": sorted(payload.get("source_buckets", [])),
                "target_buckets": sorted(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "resolved_target": bool(payload.get("target_files", [])),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("target_file_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("source_file_count", 0)),
            item.get("action_key", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "action_count": len(rows),
        "resolved_action_count": sum(1 for row in rows if row.get("resolved_target")),
        "actions": rows,
    }


def build_ui_action_hotspots(
    ui_action_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 20,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    hotspots: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for action_key, payload in ui_action_index.items():
        hotspots.append(
            {
                "action_key": action_key,
                "source_symbol": str(payload.get("source_symbol", "")),
                "signal_name": str(payload.get("signal_name", "")),
                "target": str(payload.get("target", "")),
                "source_file_count": len(payload.get("source_files", [])),
                "target_file_count": len(payload.get("target_files", [])),
                "target_bucket_count": len(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "target_buckets": sorted(payload.get("target_buckets", [])),
                "resolved_target": bool(payload.get("target_files", [])),
            }
        )

    hotspots.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -int(item.get("target_file_count", 0)),
            -int(item.get("source_file_count", 0)),
            item.get("action_key", ""),
        )
    )

    return hotspots[:limit]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                call_name = call.get("call_name", "")
                if ".connect" in call_name or call_name.endswith("connect"):
                    results.append(
                        {
                            "source_file": path,
                            "source_symbol": fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", "")),
                            "signal_name": call_name,
                            "target": "unknown",
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            "confidence": 0.65,
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    call_name = call.get("call_name", "")
                    if ".connect" in call_name or call_name.endswith("connect"):
                        results.append(
                            {
                                "source_file": path,
                                "source_symbol": method.get("qualname", method.get("name", "")),
                                "signal_name": call_name,
                                "target": "unknown",
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                                "confidence": 0.65,
                            }
                        )

    return results

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def _extract_target_from_call(call: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str, float]:
    raw_target = call.get("target", "")
    target = str(raw_target or "").strip()

    if target and target.lower() != "unknown":
        lowered = target.lower()

        if lowered.startswith("lambda"):
            return target, "lambda", 0.75

        if "partial(" in lowered:
            return target, "partial", 0.80

        if "." in target:
            return target, "method", 0.95

        return target, "function", 0.90

    lambda_target = str(call.get("lambda_target", "") or "").strip()
    if lambda_target:
        return lambda_target, "lambda", 0.75

    partial_target = str(call.get("partial_target", "") or "").strip()
    if partial_target:
        return partial_target, "partial", 0.80

    callable_name = str(call.get("callable_name", "") or "").strip()
    if callable_name:
        if "." in callable_name:
            return callable_name, "method", 0.95
        return callable_name, "function", 0.90

    handler_name = str(call.get("handler_name", "") or "").strip()
    if handler_name:
        if "." in handler_name:
            return handler_name, "method", 0.95
        return handler_name, "function", 0.90

    return "unknown", "unknown", 0.30


def _build_signal_record(
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    call: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    signal_name = str(call.get("call_name", "") or "").strip()
    target, target_kind, target_confidence = _extract_target_from_call(call)

    return {
        "source_file": source_file,
        "source_symbol": source_symbol,
        "signal_name": signal_name,
        "target": target,
        "target_kind": target_kind,
        "target_confidence": target_confidence,
        "line": call.get("lineno"),
        "confidence": target_confidence,
    }


def extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = str(file_record.get("path", "") or "")

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            source_symbol = str(fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", "")) or "")

            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                call_name = str(call.get("call_name", "") or "").strip()
                if ".connect" in call_name or call_name.endswith("connect"):
                    results.append(
                        _build_signal_record(
                            source_file=path,
                            source_symbol=source_symbol,
                            call=call,
                        )
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                source_symbol = str(method.get("qualname", method.get("name", "")) or "")

                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    call_name = str(call.get("call_name", "") or "").strip()
                    if ".connect" in call_name or call_name.endswith("connect"):
                        results.append(
                            _build_signal_record(
                                source_file=path,
                                source_symbol=source_symbol,
                                call=call,
                            )
                        )

    return results

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow
from collector_docstrings import build_docstring_summary
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text
from collector_warnings import parse_python_source_with_warnings


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(
    source: str,
    tree: ast.AST | None,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    if tree is not None:
        try:
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                    value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                    if value:
                        strings.append(value)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    docstring = _get_docstring(node)
    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": docstring,
        "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(docstring),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
        "data_flow": build_data_flow(node),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree, parse_warning_error, parse_warnings = parse_python_source_with_warnings(source)
        if parse_warning_error is not None or tree is None:
            return None, parse_warning_error
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source, tree)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]
            class_docstring = _get_docstring(node)

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": class_docstring,
                    "docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(class_docstring),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "module_docstring_summary": build_docstring_summary(module_docstring),
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "parse_warnings": parse_warnings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return p
